poses.name: Bat swing
poses.desc: The figure is mid-swing with an invisible bat, seen from the front. The feet are planted wide, the front left foot flat, the back right heel lifted as the hips rotate. Both hands are joined in front of the body at waist height, arms extended, as if swinging a long bat through the ball. The torso twists hard toward the front foot. The head stays down toward the contact point.

poses.name: Boxing guard
poses.desc: The figure stands in a compact fighting stance, turned slightly to the right of the camera. The left foot is forward, the right foot back, knees softly bent, weight centered. Both arms are raised with elbows tucked close to the ribs. The left fist is level with the cheek, the right fist held just beside the chin. The torso is upright and the chin is tucked, head facing forward.

poses.name: Backbend bridge
poses.desc: The figure arches into a full backbend bridge, seen in profile. Both feet are flat on the ground hip-width apart with knees bent. Both hands are planted flat behind the head with fingers pointing toward the feet, arms straight. The hips press upward to the highest point and the spine forms a smooth arch. The head hangs down between the arms, facing the ground.

poses.name: Cartwheel mid-way
poses.desc: The figure is halfway through a cartwheel, fully inverted and viewed from the front. Both hands are planted on the ground shoulder-width apart with arms straight. The legs are split wide in a straddle above, forming a star shape with the arms, toes pointed. The torso is vertical and straight. The head is between the arms, facing the camera.

poses.name: Catching overhead
poses.desc: The figure leaps slightly off the ground, facing the camera, with both knees bent and feet trailing beneath the body. Both arms reach up and forward above the head with hands open and fingers spread, palms facing out, as if about to catch a ball. The torso stretches tall with a slight backward arch. The head tips back, looking up at the hands.

poses.name: Cycling crouch
poses.desc: The figure is bent into a racing cycling position in profile, as if on an invisible bike. The torso is folded forward nearly horizontal. Both arms reach forward and down with elbows bent, hands closed as if gripping low handlebars. The right leg is extended down at the bottom of a pedal stroke, the left knee is raised high at the top. The head tilts up to look ahead.

poses.name: Deadlift pull
poses.desc: The figure is at the start of a deadlift, seen from the side. Both feet are flat and hip-width apart. The knees are bent and the hips are pushed back, torso hinged forward at about forty-five degrees with a flat back. Both arms hang straight down outside the knees, hands closed as if gripping a bar at shin height. The head is in line with the spine, looking slightly ahead.

poses.name: Deep squat
poses.desc: The figure holds the bottom of a bodyweight squat, facing the camera. Both feet are planted slightly wider than the shoulders with toes turned out, heels down. The knees are bent deeply and track over the toes, thighs below parallel. The torso leans slightly forward with a flat back. Both arms are extended straight in front at shoulder height, palms down. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Downward dog
poses.desc: The figure forms an inverted V shape in profile. Both hands press flat on the ground shoulder-width apart with arms straight and fingers spread. Both feet are planted hip-width apart with heels pushing toward the ground and legs straight. The hips are lifted to the highest point, the back is long and flat. The head hangs between the upper arms, looking back toward the feet.

poses.name: Full sprint
poses.desc: The figure is caught mid-stride at full speed in profile, fully airborne. The right knee drives high in front with the foot flexed, while the left leg trails straight behind with toes pointed. The torso leans forward with a slight twist. The left arm swings forward with a bent elbow and loose fist, the right arm pumps back. The head faces straight ahead.

poses.name: Goalkeeper dive
poses.desc: The figure is fully airborne and horizontal, diving sideways to the left, viewed from the front. Both arms extend in line with the body toward the upper left with hands open and fingers spread, as if reaching for a ball. The torso is stretched long. The right leg pushes off straight behind, the left leg bends slightly at the knee. The head faces along the arms.

poses.name: Golf swing finish
poses.desc: The figure holds the finish of a golf swing, facing the camera. Weight rests on the straight left leg, foot flat; the right foot is up on its toes with the knee turned in. The hips and chest rotate fully toward the target on the left. Both hands are held together high above the left shoulder as if gripping a club. The head turns to follow the shot.

poses.name: Straight handstand
poses.desc: The figure holds a straight handstand, viewed from the front. Both hands are planted on the ground shoulder-width apart with fingers spread, arms locked straight. The body stacks vertically in one line: shoulders over wrists, hips over shoulders. Both legs are together and straight, pointing to the sky with toes pointed. The head is held between the arms, facing down at the floor.

poses.name: High kick
poses.desc: The figure balances on the straight left leg, in profile, with the foot flat. The right leg swings up in a high crescent kick to head height with the knee nearly straight and the foot flexed. The torso leans back slightly to counterbalance. Both arms are bent with loose fists held in front of the chest for guard. The head stays level, looking toward the kick.

poses.name: Horse stance
poses.desc: The figure stands in a wide, low martial arts horse stance, facing the camera. Both feet are planted about twice shoulder width apart, parallel, with the knees bent deeply and pushed outward so the thighs are nearly level. The torso is upright and square to the camera. Both arms are bent with fists pulled back to the hips, palms up. The head faces straight ahead.

poses.name: Hurdle clearance
poses.desc: The figure clears an invisible hurdle in profile, airborne. The lead right leg extends straight forward with the foot flexed. The trailing left leg is bent and swept out to the side, knee pointing outward and foot tucked up level with the hip. The torso leans sharply forward over the lead leg. The left arm reaches toward the lead foot; the right arm bends back. The head looks forward.

poses.name: Basketball jump shot
poses.desc: The figure hangs airborne at the top of a jump, facing the camera, with both legs slightly bent and feet together below the body. The torso is upright. The right arm extends above the head with the elbow nearly straight and the wrist snapped forward, fingers hanging down as if releasing a ball. The left hand hovers beside it, open, as a guide. The head looks up toward the hands.

poses.name: Kicking a ball
poses.desc: The figure stands on the planted left foot with the knee slightly bent, viewed from a three-quarter front angle. The right leg swings forward at hip height with the knee straightening and the foot angled as if striking a ball. The torso leans back and twists slightly left. The left arm extends out to the side for balance, the right arm bends back. The head looks down at the kick.

poses.name: Long jump mid-air
poses.desc: The figure is airborne in the flight phase of a long jump, seen in profile. Both legs are drawn forward with knees bent and feet reaching ahead as if preparing to land. The torso folds slightly forward at the hips. Both arms sweep forward and down past the knees with hands open, palms facing back. The head is tilted down toward the feet.

poses.name: Forward lunge
poses.desc: The figure steps into a deep forward lunge, viewed from a three-quarter angle. The front right knee is bent to a right angle with the foot flat; the back left knee hovers just above the ground with the heel lifted. The torso stays upright over the hips. Both hands rest on the hips with elbows pointing out. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Overhead press
poses.desc: The figure stands tall facing the camera with feet hip-width apart and both legs straight. The torso is upright with the core braced. Both arms are pushed fully overhead, elbows locked, hands closed in fists about shoulder-width apart as if holding a bar above the head. The upper arms are beside the ears. The head is level and looks straight forward.

poses.name: Plank hold
poses.desc: The figure holds a high plank in profile, body forming one straight line from head to heels. Both hands are planted flat directly under the shoulders with arms straight and elbows locked. The feet rest on the toes, hip-width apart, legs straight. The hips are level with the shoulders, neither sagging nor raised. The head is neutral, looking at the ground slightly ahead of the hands.

poses.name: Punch extended
poses.desc: The figure throws a straight punch into empty air, seen from a three-quarter angle. The right arm extends fully forward at shoulder height, fist clenched and rotated palm-down. The left arm stays bent with the fist guarding the chin. The left foot is forward and the rear right heel lifts as the hips rotate into the punch. The torso twists left and leans slightly forward. The head faces the punch.

poses.name: Push-up low
poses.desc: The figure is at the bottom of a push-up in profile. Both palms press into the ground just wider than the shoulders with elbows bent to ninety degrees and pointing back at a slight angle. The chest hovers close to the ground. The legs are straight, resting on the toes, with the body in a rigid line. The head is neutral, looking down.

poses.name: Rowing stroke
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground in profile as if on a rowing seat, at the finish of a stroke. Both legs are extended forward with knees nearly straight and feet flexed. The torso leans back about twenty degrees from vertical. Both arms are bent with elbows pulled back past the ribs and hands closed near the lower chest as if gripping a handle. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Skateboard stance
poses.desc: The figure crouches as if riding a skateboard, body turned sideways to the camera. Both feet are spread wide on an invisible board, the left foot forward and angled, the right foot at the back, knees bent deeply. The torso leans slightly forward and twists so the chest faces partly toward the camera. The arms hang loosely bent at the sides with open hands. The head turns to look forward.

poses.name: Sprint start
poses.desc: The figure crouches in a sprinter's starting position, viewed from the side. Both hands are planted on the ground shoulder-width apart with fingers spread, arms straight. The left foot is forward with the knee bent sharply, the right leg stretched back with the ball of the foot pressed down. Hips are raised above the shoulders, torso angled downward, head low and looking at the ground ahead.

poses.name: Swimming dive
poses.desc: The figure is airborne in a streamlined dive, angled head-first downward in profile. Both arms stretch straight overhead with the hands stacked one on top of the other and the upper arms squeezing the ears. The torso is long and straight. Both legs extend together behind with toes pointed. The head is tucked between the arms, looking along the line of the hands.

poses.name: Tennis serve
poses.desc: The figure stands facing slightly sideways with feet staggered, weight rising onto the toes of the front left foot while the back right heel lifts. The torso arches back and twists to the right. The left arm reaches straight up as if having just tossed a ball. The right arm is cocked behind the head with the elbow high, hand gripping as if holding a racket. The head tilts up.

poses.name: Overhand throw
poses.desc: The figure is in the cocked phase of an overhand throw, seen from a three-quarter front angle. The left foot strides forward, the right foot pushes back on its toes. Hips and shoulders twist right. The right arm is raised behind the head with the elbow bent and hand open as if gripping a ball. The left arm points forward at the target. The head faces the target.

poses.name: Tree pose
poses.desc: The figure balances on the straight left leg, facing the camera. The right foot is pressed flat against the inner left thigh with the right knee pointing out to the side. The torso is tall and centered over the hips. Both hands meet palm to palm in front of the chest, elbows pointing outward. The head is level, facing forward.

poses.name: Vertical jump arms up
poses.desc: The figure is airborne at the peak of a straight vertical jump, facing the camera. Both legs hang straight down together with toes pointed. The torso is upright and fully extended. Both arms reach straight overhead, fingers stretched toward the sky, upper arms framing the head. The head tilts slightly back, looking up toward the hands.

poses.name: Volleyball spike
poses.desc: The figure is airborne at the top of a jump, viewed from a three-quarter angle, both knees bent and trailing slightly back. The torso arches back. The right arm is cocked high with the elbow bent and the hand open above and behind the head, ready to strike down. The left arm is extended forward and slightly down for balance. The head looks up at the strike point.

poses.name: Climbing a wall
poses.desc: The figure climbs an invisible vertical wall, seen from behind at a slight angle. The right hand reaches high overhead with fingers curled as if gripping a hold; the left hand grips at shoulder level. The left foot is raised with the knee bent out to the side, toes pressing in; the right leg is straight below, toes braced. The torso presses close to the wall. The head tilts up.

poses.name: Yoga warrior pose
poses.desc: The figure stands in a wide stance in profile, the front right knee bent to a right angle directly over the ankle, the back left leg straight with the foot turned slightly outward and flat on the ground. Hips and torso face sideways and stay upright. Both arms extend horizontally in opposite directions at shoulder height, palms down. The head turns to look over the front hand.

poses.name: Arched profile
poses.desc: The figure is shown from the waist up in strict side view. The back arches so the chest lifts forward and the shoulders draw back. One hand rises to the back of the neck with the elbow pointing up, the other arm hangs relaxed behind the hip. The head tips back with the chin lifted, the throat long.

poses.name: Forearm over the eyes
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back on an implied bed, seen from the side. One forearm drapes across the forehead just above the eyes, the elbow pointing up and out. The other hand rests lightly on the stomach. The near knee bends up and falls inward across the straight far leg, toes pointed, and the chest lifts slightly as the head tips back into the mattress.

poses.name: Back view hair up
poses.desc: The figure stands fully with its back to the camera, feet close together and weight on one leg, the other heel lifted. Both arms rise and gather the hair on top of the head, elbows spread wide. The lower back arches deeply and the hips drop toward the standing leg. The head turns into profile over one shoulder.

poses.name: Bare back glance
poses.desc: The figure is shown from the waist up with its back to the camera. The near shoulder drops and rolls slightly forward while the far shoulder stays high. The far hand reaches across and rests on the near shoulder, elbow in front of the chest. The head turns over the dropped shoulder into profile, chin close to it, the spine long down the middle of the back.

poses.name: Bathtub leg up
poses.desc: The figure semi-reclines in an implied bathtub in side view, the upper back resting against the sloped end of the tub. One leg rises straight up out of the tub with the toes pointed, the foot reaching above the rim. The other knee bends with only the knee showing above the rim. Both arms rest along the rims of the tub and the head tips back with the chin lifted.

poses.name: Bed edge crossed recline
poses.desc: The figure lies back across an implied bed from its edge, seen in side view, the hips at the edge and the upper back flat on the mattress. The legs hang over the edge crossed high at the knee, the top foot pointed and the bottom foot on tiptoe on the floor. Both arms bend overhead, hands resting on the mattress near the head. The chest lifts in a soft arch and the head turns toward the camera.

poses.name: Bed edge forward lean
poses.desc: The figure sits on the edge of an implied bed facing the camera, knees pressed together and the feet apart on tiptoe on the floor. The torso leans forward with both elbows resting on the knees and the chin resting on the hands. The shoulders round slightly forward and the back stays long. The head tilts to one side with the eyes on the camera.

poses.name: Bed kneel look back
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright on an implied bed with its back to the camera, knees hip-width apart and the hips lifted off the heels. The hips shift to one side and the lower back arches. One hand rests at the nape of the neck, elbow raised, while the other hangs at the side touching the thigh. The head turns over the raised elbow's shoulder to look back toward the camera.

poses.name: Chest forward lean
poses.desc: The figure is shown from the waist up facing the camera, the torso leaning forward toward the lens from the hips. Both arms hang straight down in front of the body with the hands loosely clasped at hip level, so the upper arms press gently inward against the sides. The shoulders roll slightly forward and down. The chin lowers while the head tilts up toward the camera.

poses.name: Crawl toward camera
poses.desc: The figure is on hands and knees on an implied bed facing the camera, seen in three-quarter view. One hand reaches forward mid-step while the opposite knee slides forward. The shoulders sit low between the arms and the back dips into an arch, the hips higher than the shoulders. The head lifts to look straight at the camera.

poses.name: Doorway stretch
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera inside an implied doorway, both arms raised and the hands pressed against the two sides of the frame above the head. The weight sits on one leg with that hip pushed out and the other knee bent across with the heel lifted. The torso stretches long with a slight arch. The head tilts to one side and rests against the raised arm.

poses.name: Sitting against the bed
poses.desc: The figure sits on the floor in three-quarter view with its back against the side of an implied bed. One knee is drawn up with the foot flat, the forearm draped over that knee and the wrist hanging. The other leg lies folded flat on the floor. The other arm reaches back with the elbow resting on the mattress, and the head drops back onto the mattress edge, turned toward the camera.

poses.name: Hands clasped behind back
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on one leg and the other knee bent and turned inward. Both hands clasp behind the lower back, pulling the shoulders back and down so the chest opens and lifts. The hips shift toward the standing leg. The chin lowers and the head tilts slightly, eyes on the camera.

poses.name: Hands in hair arch
poses.desc: The figure is shown from the waist up facing the camera. Both hands sweep up into the hair at the sides of the head, elbows raised wide and high. The back arches so the chest lifts forward and the shoulders draw back. The head tilts back and to one side with the chin lifted.

poses.name: Headboard kneel
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright on an implied bed facing an implied headboard, back to the camera and seen in three-quarter view. Both hands grip the top of the headboard at shoulder height, arms bent. The hips push back slightly and the lower back arches, knees together. The head turns over one shoulder toward the camera with the chin lowered.

poses.name: Heel strap adjust
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view with its back partly to the camera, balancing on one straight leg. The other knee bends and the foot lifts behind, and the hand on that side reaches back to hold the heel of the shoe. The other arm extends out for balance. The torso leans slightly forward and twists, and the head looks back over the shoulder at the raised foot.

poses.name: Knee on the bed
poses.desc: The figure stands beside an implied bed with its back to the camera, seen in three-quarter view, one knee placed up on the mattress and the other leg standing straight on the floor. The torso leans forward with one hand planted on the mattress, arm straight. The lower back arches. The head turns back over the shoulder to look at the camera.

poses.name: Kneeling forward lean
poses.desc: The figure kneels on an implied bed facing the camera, knees together and sitting high off the heels. The torso leans forward from the hips, both arms straight with the palms planted on the mattress just in front of the knees and the arms close to the body. The shoulders draw slightly forward and inward, the chest forward. The chin lifts and the head tilts toward one shoulder, facing the camera.

poses.name: Legs up, ankles crossed
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back on an implied bed in side view, the hips close to an implied wall. Both legs rise straight up together and rest against the wall, crossed at the ankles with the toes pointed. Both arms stretch overhead along the mattress, elbows soft and hands loosely open. The head tips back and turns slightly toward the camera.

poses.name: Back view mirror selfie
poses.desc: The figure stands with its back to an implied mirror and the camera, weight on one leg and the hip pushed out to the side. The torso twists so one shoulder turns back, and that arm raises an implied phone over the shoulder at head height. The other hand rests at the lower back. The head turns to look over the shoulder at the phone, and the lower back arches.

poses.name: Mirror selfie hip pop
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view facing an implied mirror, weight on one leg with that hip pushed far out and the other knee bent inward with the heel raised. One hand raises an implied phone at face height in front of the face, elbow bent and tucked. The other hand rests on the pushed-out hip. The shoulders angle back and the chest turns slightly toward the mirror.

poses.name: Morning bed stretch
poses.desc: The figure sits up on an implied bed in three-quarter view, legs extended forward together with the knees soft and toes pointed. Both arms stretch straight overhead, one hand holding the opposite wrist. The spine lengthens and arches back slightly, the chest lifting. The head tilts back and to one side with the eyes closed in a waking stretch.

poses.name: Overhead pull
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view, weight on one leg and the other knee softly bent. Both arms cross at the wrists above the head, elbows bent, as if pulling an implied top up and off. The torso stretches long with the ribs lifted and the back gently arched. The head ducks slightly forward between the raised arms and turns toward the camera.

poses.name: Pillow hug
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach on an implied bed with its back toward the camera, seen in three-quarter view from above, both arms wrapped around an implied pillow under the head. The face turns to the side and rests on the pillow, looking back toward the camera. One knee draws up and out to the side along the mattress while the other leg stays straight. The spine curves gently from the shoulders to the raised hip.

poses.name: Pillow pile recline
poses.desc: The figure semi-reclines on an implied bed against stacked pillows at the headboard, seen in three-quarter view. One arm bends behind the head with the elbow raised. The legs extend toward the foot of the bed; one knee bends and crosses over the straight leg, foot pointed. The other hand rests on the mattress beside the hip, and the head tilts toward the raised elbow, facing the camera.

poses.name: Cheek on arms, heel up
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach on an implied bed in three-quarter view, both forearms folded under the head with one cheek resting on them and the face turned toward the camera. The lower back softens into a gentle arch so the hips lift slightly from the mattress. One knee bends and the lower leg rises with the toes pointed, while the other leg stays long. The shoulders relax and the elbows spread wide.

poses.name: Prone look back
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach on an implied bed, seen in three-quarter view from behind and to the side, legs together and extended long with the toes pointed. The torso twists up onto one elbow so the near shoulder lifts and the upper back turns toward the camera. The head turns back over that raised shoulder to look at the camera. The free hand rests flat on the mattress in front of the chest, and the lower back arches softly.

poses.name: Robe slipping off
poses.desc: The figure stands with its back to the camera, weight on one leg and the other knee softly bent. Both hands hold an implied robe at the elbows, letting it slip down off both shoulders to the middle of the back. The shoulder blades draw together and the spine lengthens. The head turns to one side in profile, chin dropped toward the shoulder.

poses.name: Shower hair rinse
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view from behind, as if under an implied shower, weight on one leg and the hip shifted out. Both hands rise and push the hair back from the forehead, elbows lifted high and pointing forward. The head tips back with the face turned up, and the back arches so the chest lifts. The free knee bends in toward the standing leg.

poses.name: Side lie hip trace
poses.desc: The figure lies on its side facing the camera on an implied bed, the head resting on the bent lower arm. The top hand trails down along the top hip with the fingertips light, the elbow lifted. The top leg bends forward over the straight bottom leg, knee resting on the mattress, so the waist dips and the hip rises in a strong curve. The head tilts slightly toward the camera.

poses.name: Sofa backrest kneel
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the seat of an implied sofa facing the backrest, back to the camera and seen in three-quarter view. Both forearms fold over the top of the backrest and the chin rests on the stacked hands. The knees are together and the hips sit high off the heels, lower back arched. The head turns back over one shoulder toward the camera.

poses.name: Sofa stretch
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back along an implied sofa in side view, the head resting on the armrest. Both arms stretch overhead past the armrest, hands loosely clasped. The near knee bends up with the foot flat on the cushion, the far leg extends long with pointed toes. The chest lifts in a long arch from the hips to the shoulders.

poses.name: Stocking roll
poses.desc: The figure sits on the edge of an implied bed in side view. One leg extends forward and up, knee straight and toes pointed, held at hip height. Both hands slide along the raised shin as if rolling up a stocking, the torso leaning forward over the leg with a long back. The other foot rests on tiptoe on the floor and the head turns toward the camera.

poses.name: Tub kneel back view
poses.desc: The figure kneels in an implied bathtub with its back to the camera, seen in three-quarter view, sitting high off the heels with knees together. Both forearms rest folded on the far rim of the tub. The lower back arches and the shoulders relax. The head turns back over one shoulder to look at the camera, cheek near the shoulder.

poses.name: Upside-down gaze
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back on an implied bed with the head toward the camera, seen from above at a low angle, so the face appears upside down. Both arms bend up and rest on the mattress to either side of the head, framing it, with the hair spread out. The torso extends away from the camera and the knees bend up together with the feet flat. The chin lifts slightly.

poses.name: Vanity mirror lean
poses.desc: The figure stands with its back to the camera, leaning toward an implied mirror over a waist-high dresser. Both hands rest flat on the dresser top, arms straight and shoulder-width apart. The hips draw back a little and the lower back arches, feet close with one heel lifted. The head lifts and turns slightly to one side, as if looking at the reflection.

poses.name: Bridal carry
poses.desc: Person A stands upright in three-quarter view, carrying person B across the chest. Person A's near arm supports person B's back below the shoulders and the far arm supports under person B's knees. Person B's arms wrap around person A's neck, legs together and toes pointed. Their heads turn toward each other, close.

poses.name: Cheek kiss from behind
poses.desc: Person A stands just behind person B's shoulder, one arm wrapped around person B's waist, and leans in to press a kiss to person B's cheek. Person B faces three-quarter toward the camera, turns the head back toward person A and raises the near hand to rest on person A's cheek. Person B's other hand covers person A's hand at the waist.

poses.name: Cheek to cheek dance
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand in a close dance hold, chests touching. Person A's right hand rests on person B's upper back. Their other hands join and extend out to the side at shoulder height, elbows soft. Person B's left hand rests on person A's shoulder. Their cheeks press together, both heads facing the joined hands.

poses.name: Close whisper embrace
poses.desc: Person A stands just behind and beside person B, one arm around person B's waist, leaning in with the lips at person B's ear. Person B faces three-quarter toward the camera, tilts the head toward person A and reaches the near hand back to rest on the back of person A's neck. Person B's other hand rests on person A's arm.

poses.name: Dramatic dip kiss
poses.desc: Person A lunges forward on a bent front knee, one arm behind person B's upper back and the other at person B's waist. Person B leans back almost horizontally, supported by person A, one leg extended to the floor and the other knee bent and lifted. Person B's near arm circles person A's neck, the far arm trails toward the floor. Person A leans in to kiss.

poses.name: Embrace from behind
poses.desc: Person A stands behind person B, both facing the camera. Person A's arms wrap around person B's waist with the hands crossed over person B's stomach, and person A's chin rests on person B's shoulder. Person B's hands rest over person A's forearms and person B's head tilts toward person A's head.

poses.name: Face to face lying
poses.desc: Person A and person B lie on their sides facing each other on an implied bed, heads on the mattress a few inches apart. Their knees bend and touch between them. Their hands join and rest between their chests, fingers interlaced. Person A's free arm reaches over to rest on person B's waist.

poses.name: First look tap
poses.desc: Person A stands facing away from person B with the back toward person B, arms relaxed and head slightly bowed. Person B approaches from behind, one foot stepping forward, and reaches out to tap person A's shoulder with one hand while the other hand rests at person B's chest. Person A's head begins to turn over the shoulder.

poses.name: Forehead kiss
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in profile with their arms around each other's waists. Person A tilts the head down and presses the lips to person B's forehead. Person B bows the head slightly forward to receive it, hands resting at person A's sides. Their hips and chests touch.

poses.name: Forehead to forehead
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in profile, close together. Their heads bow slightly so their foreheads rest together. Person A's hands hold person B's waist. Person B's hands rest flat against person A's chest, elbows bent and close to the body. Their feet are close, toes almost touching.

poses.name: Hand in hand gaze
poses.desc: Person A and person B walk side by side toward the camera, mid-stride with opposite feet forward. Their inner hands join between them, arms relaxed and slightly swinging. Their outer arms swing naturally. Both heads turn toward each other, chins slightly raised, shoulders angled inward.

poses.name: Hand kiss
poses.desc: Person A stands in profile, bowing slightly forward from the hips, holding person B's right hand in both hands and raising it to the lips. Person B stands upright facing person A, the right arm extended and slightly raised, the left hand resting at the chest. Person B's head tilts down toward person A.

poses.name: Head on chest lying
poses.desc: Person A lies on the back on an implied bed, one hand tucked behind the head. Person B lies on the side alongside, head resting on person A's chest and one arm draped across person A's torso. Person A's other arm curls around person B's shoulders. Person B's top knee bends and rests over person A's near thigh.

poses.name: Hugging lift
poses.desc: Person A stands with the feet planted and knees slightly bent, arms wrapped around the backs of person B's thighs, lifting person B so person B's hips are at person A's chest. Person B's arms rest around person A's neck and person B's lower legs bend back. Person A looks up and person B bows the head down so their foreheads nearly meet.

poses.name: Leaning over kiss lying
poses.desc: Person A lies on the back on implied grass, legs extended and one knee bent. Person B lies on the stomach beside person A, propped on both elbows, chest angled over person A's shoulder, and leans down to kiss person A. Person A's near hand reaches up to rest on person B's cheek. Person B's lower legs lift behind with ankles crossed.

poses.name: Legs over lap
poses.desc: Person A sits upright on an implied bench facing the camera. Person B sits beside person A angled inward, legs draped across person A's thighs with the knees bent. Person A's near arm wraps around person B's back and the other hand rests on person B's knees. Person B's arm circles person A's neck and their heads lean together.

poses.name: Lying head to head
poses.desc: Person A and person B lie on their backs on implied grass in opposite directions, the tops of their heads side by side. Their near arms bend upward and their hands interlace just above their heads. Their legs extend away from each other with one knee bent. Their heads tilt toward each other.

poses.name: Nestled seated lean
poses.desc: Person A sits on the ground facing the camera with knees bent and apart. Person B sits between person A's legs, knees bent together, leaning back against person A's chest. Person A's arms wrap around person B's shoulders and person A's chin rests on top of person B's head. Person B's hands hold person A's forearms.

poses.name: Nose to nose
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in profile with their noses touching and heads tilted slightly. Person A's hands gently cup both sides of person B's jaw. Person B's hands hold person A's wrists, elbows lowered. Their bodies lean in from the hips, chests nearly touching.

poses.name: One-knee proposal
poses.desc: Person A kneels on one knee in profile facing person B, the other foot planted forward. Person A holds person B's left hand in both hands raised at chest height. Person B stands facing person A, the right hand pressed to the chest, upper body leaning slightly back. Person A's head tilts up toward person B.

poses.name: Piggyback cheek kiss
poses.desc: Person A stands facing the camera carrying person B piggyback, hands holding the backs of person B's knees. Person B's legs wrap at person A's sides with the lower legs hanging in front. Person B's arms circle person A's shoulders and person B leans forward around person A's head to kiss person A's cheek. Person A's head turns toward person B.

poses.name: Running leap hug
poses.desc: Person B leaps into person A's arms, feet off the ground with both lower legs kicked back behind and the knees bent. Person B's arms wrap around person A's neck. Person A stands with the knees bent and one foot stepped back to brace, arms wrapped around person B's waist, leaning slightly back. Their cheeks press together.

poses.name: Seated forehead touch
poses.desc: Person A and person B sit cross-legged on the ground facing each other in profile, knees touching. They lean forward from the hips until their foreheads rest together. Their hands join between them above their knees, fingers interlaced. Their shoulders relax and round slightly toward each other.

poses.name: Sideways lap sit
poses.desc: Person A sits on an implied chair facing the camera, knees together and feet flat. Person B sits sideways across person A's lap, legs together and angled off one side with feet dangling. Person A's arms circle person B's waist. Person B's arm wraps around person A's shoulders and person B's head rests against person A's temple.

poses.name: Slow dance sway
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in profile, feet close and weight shifting side to side. Person A's arms wrap low around person B's waist. Person B's arms drape over person A's shoulders, wrists crossing behind person A's neck. Person B's cheek rests on person A's chest and person A's head bows over person B.

poses.name: Sofa recline cuddle
poses.desc: Person A sits reclined into the corner of an implied sofa, legs extended along it. Person B lies along the sofa between person A's legs on the back, the upper back resting against person A's chest, legs extended with ankles crossed. Person A's arms wrap around person B's shoulders. Person B's head tips back against person A's shoulder.

poses.name: Spooning on bed
poses.desc: Person A and person B lie on their sides on an implied bed, both facing the camera, person A behind. Person A's knees tuck behind person B's knees in matching bends. Person A's top arm drapes over person B's waist, hand resting in front of person B's stomach. Person B's head rests on person A's lower arm.

poses.name: Standing embrace kiss
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in profile, bodies pressed close from chest to hips. Person A's arms wrap around person B's waist. Person B's arms circle person A's neck, forearms resting on person A's shoulders. Their heads tilt in opposite directions and meet in a kiss, person A's head slightly lowered.

poses.name: Tiptoe kiss
poses.desc: Person A and person B face each other in profile. Person B rises onto tiptoe on one foot, the other heel kicked up behind with the knee bent, and rests both hands on person A's shoulders. Person A stands upright, arms around person B's waist, and bends the head down. Their lips meet in a kiss.

poses.name: Underarm twirl
poses.desc: Person A stands in three-quarter view, raising the right hand above person B's head while holding person B's left hand. Person B turns under the raised arms mid-spin on the ball of one foot, the other leg lifted slightly behind with bent knee. Person B's free arm extends out to the side. Person A's free hand rests at the hip.

poses.name: Ballet arabesque
poses.desc: The figure balances on the straight left leg in profile, foot flat on the ground. The right leg extends straight behind at hip height with the toes pointed. The torso stays lifted and tilts only slightly forward. The left arm reaches forward at shoulder height with the palm down; the right arm extends back along the line of the raised leg. The head is lifted, looking past the front hand.

poses.name: Arm wave
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Both arms are extended out to the sides at shoulder height, forming a continuous rippling wave: the left arm dips at the elbow with the hand up, the right arm rises at the elbow with the hand dropped. The shoulders tilt to follow the wave. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Ballet attitude
poses.desc: The figure balances on the straight right leg, viewed from a three-quarter front angle. The left leg is lifted behind at hip height with the knee bent to about ninety degrees and turned out, foot pointed. The torso stays tall with a slight forward lean. The left arm is raised overhead in a rounded curve; the right arm opens to the side. The head turns slightly toward the open arm.

poses.name: Ballroom frame
poses.desc: The figure stands alone in a ballroom dance frame, seen from a three-quarter angle. Feet are close together, left foot slightly forward, legs straight. The torso is tall with the chest lifted. The left arm is raised to the side at shoulder height, elbow bent, hand open as if holding a partner's hand; the right arm is bent with the hand forward at shoulder level. The head turns left.

poses.name: Charleston kick
poses.desc: The figure hops on the left foot, which is on the ground with the knee bent, facing the camera. The right leg kicks forward and across the body with the knee bent and the foot flicked out. The torso leans back slightly. Both arms swing in opposition: the left arm forward at waist height and the right arm back, hands loose and open. The head tilts to the left.

poses.name: Conductor raised arms
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and knees softly bent, as if about to cue an orchestra. The torso is lifted and leans slightly forward. Both arms are raised high above the head at shoulder width, the right hand pinched as if holding a baton, the left hand open with the palm facing forward. The head tilts up toward the hands.

poses.name: Final bow
poses.desc: The figure takes a deep bow at the end of a performance, facing the camera. Both feet are together and flat, legs straight. The torso bends forward from the hips to about horizontal. The right arm sweeps across the body with the hand at the waist; the left arm extends out and back behind the figure, palm up. The head bows down toward the floor.

poses.name: First position arms rounded
poses.desc: The figure stands upright facing the camera with heels together and both feet turned outward in a V shape, legs straight. The torso is tall with the shoulders down. Both arms are held low in front of the thighs in a rounded oval, elbows softly bent, fingertips almost touching, palms facing the body. The head is level and faces forward.

poses.name: Flamenco arm line
poses.desc: The figure stands tall with weight on the straight right leg, the left foot placed slightly forward with the heel raised. The torso is upright with a lifted chest and a slight twist left. The right arm curves high over the head with the wrist turned and fingers spread; the left arm curves low in front of the hip. The head turns in profile to the left.

poses.name: Contemporary floor reach
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the left knee with the right leg extended straight out to the side, foot flexed, viewed from a three-quarter angle. The torso folds sideways and forward over the extended leg. The right arm sweeps along the ground past the extended foot with an open hand; the left arm arcs overhead reaching the same direction. The head is tucked down toward the right arm.

poses.name: Grand jete leap
poses.desc: The figure is airborne in a full split leap, viewed in profile. The front left leg extends straight forward and the back right leg stretches straight behind, both parallel to the ground with toes pointed. The torso is lifted and upright. Both arms are open in a wide, slightly raised V with soft hands. The head is held high, looking forward past the front leg.

poses.name: Grand plie
poses.desc: The figure sinks into a deep plie in second position, facing the camera. Both feet are planted wide apart and turned outward, heels on the ground. The knees are bent deeply and pushed out over the toes with the thighs nearly horizontal. The torso stays perfectly upright. Both arms are held rounded in front of the body at chest height, fingertips nearly touching. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Hip-hop freeze
poses.desc: The figure freezes in a low, angular hip-hop pose facing the camera. Both feet are planted wide with the right knee bent deeply and the left leg extended out to the side. The torso leans toward the bent knee and twists slightly. The right arm crosses the chest with a flat hand; the left arm points sharply down and out toward the extended leg. The head tilts to the side.

poses.name: Hula sway
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with knees softly bent and the hips swayed out to the left, weight on the left foot while the right heel lifts. The torso stays upright with a gentle counter-lean to the right. Both arms extend to the right side at shoulder height, elbows soft, the hands open and angled down with fingers together. The head turns toward the hands.

poses.name: Jazz hands
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet apart and the right knee popped slightly forward. The torso leans a little to the left. Both arms are raised to the sides at about shoulder height with elbows bent, palms facing the camera and all ten fingers spread wide and stretched. The shoulders are lifted with energy. The head tilts to the right.

poses.name: Knee slide
poses.desc: The figure slides forward on both knees, viewed from a low three-quarter front angle. Both shins rest on the ground, feet trailing behind with toes pointed. The torso leans back from the knees in a slight arch. Both arms are thrown out wide and slightly behind the body with open hands. The head is tipped back, facing upward and forward.

poses.name: Breakdance one-hand freeze
poses.desc: The figure balances inverted on the right hand alone, seen from the front. The right arm is straight and locked with the hand flat on the ground; the left arm is tucked with the hand on the hip. The hips are stacked above the supporting shoulder. Both legs are bent and tucked, knees pulled toward the chest with the feet pointing up. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: Pirouette preparation
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera in a wide fourth position, the front right foot flat with the knee bent in plie, the back left foot turned out and also bent. The torso is upright and square. The right arm curves rounded in front of the chest; the left arm opens to the side at shoulder height. The head faces forward, ready to spot the turn.

poses.name: Spin with arms wide
poses.desc: The figure spins on the ball of the right foot, facing the camera mid-rotation. The left leg lifts slightly off the ground, bent at the knee, trailing the turn. The torso is upright and turns to the left. Both arms are thrown wide open and level at shoulder height with open hands, slightly trailing the spin. The head is turned toward the direction of the turn.

poses.name: Vogue angular pose
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with the weight shifted onto the straight left leg and the right knee bent and crossed slightly in front. The torso tilts to the right. The right arm bends sharply with the hand framing the side of the head, fingers straight. The left arm bends at a right angle across the waist with the hand flat. The head turns to the left.

poses.name: Walking arm in arm
poses.desc: Person A and person B walk side by side toward the camera, person A on the left. Person B's left arm is hooked through the crook of person A's right elbow, forearms linked and close to the body. Each person's free arm swings naturally. Both are mid-stride with the inside legs stepping forward at the same time.

poses.name: Back to back
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand upright with their backs pressed together, shoulder blades touching, both facing outward and seen from the side. Person A has the arms folded across the chest, and person B stands with both hands on the hips, elbows out. Both have the feet planted shoulder width apart and the heads turned slightly toward the camera.

poses.name: Ballroom dance hold
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in a closed dance hold, turned so the camera sees them from the side. Person A's right hand rests on person B's left shoulder blade, and person B's left hand rests on person A's right upper arm. Their other hands are joined and held out to the side at shoulder height, elbows lifted.

poses.name: Bowing to each other
poses.desc: Person A on the left and person B on the right face each other in profile about two paces apart. Both bend forward from the hips to about thirty degrees with the backs straight and the heads lowered in line with the spine. Each person's arms hang straight down at the sides with the hands flat against the thighs. The feet are together.

poses.name: Riding on shoulders
poses.desc: Person A stands upright facing the camera with the feet shoulder width apart. Person B, smaller, sits on person A's shoulders with one leg hanging down on each side of person A's chest. Person A's hands hold person B's shins. Person B's arms are raised straight up overhead with the hands open.

poses.name: Comforting pat on back
poses.desc: Person A and person B sit side by side on the ground facing the camera, knees bent and feet flat. Person B on the right sits hunched forward with the elbows on the knees and the hands clasped. Person A on the left turns toward person B, with the right hand resting flat on person B's upper back and the left hand on person B's knee.

poses.name: Conga line
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand one behind the other, both facing the same direction toward the camera's right in profile. Person B is behind with both hands resting on person A's waist, elbows bent. Person A in front has both arms raised and bent, hands at head height. Both kick the right leg out to the side at the same moment.

poses.name: Leaning back holding hands
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in profile with the toes nearly touching. Each holds both of the other's hands at chest height, arms fully straight. Both lean backward away from each other with the bodies straight from heels to head, balanced by the joined hands. Both stand with the feet together and flat.

poses.name: Fist bump
poses.desc: Person A stands on the left and person B on the right, both in profile facing each other about an arm's length apart. Each extends the right arm forward at chest height with the hand closed, and the two fists touch knuckle to knuckle at the midpoint between them. Each person's left hand rests at the hip.

poses.name: Hand on shoulder from behind
poses.desc: Person B sits on an implied chair facing the camera with the forearms resting on an implied desk at waist height, hands flat. Person A stands directly behind and slightly to the left, leaning forward with the right hand resting on person B's left shoulder and the left hand pointing down toward the surface in front of person B.

poses.name: Firm handshake
poses.desc: Person A stands on the left and person B on the right, both turned slightly toward each other and toward the camera. Their right hands are clasped in a firm handshake at waist height, elbows bent at right angles. Each person's left arm hangs straight at the side. Both stand upright with the feet shoulder width apart.

poses.name: Head on shoulder sitting
poses.desc: Person A and person B sit side by side on the ground facing the camera with the legs extended forward, person A on the left. Person B leans toward person A and rests the head on person A's left shoulder. Person A's arm rests around person B's upper back. Person B's hands rest together in the lap, and person A's free hand rests on the knee.

poses.name: Helping someone up
poses.desc: Person A stands on the left with the knees slightly bent and the torso leaning forward, extending the right arm downward. Person B sits on the ground on the right with one knee bent and the other leg tucked, reaching up with the right hand to grasp person A's hand. Person A's left arm is braced on the left thigh.

poses.name: High five
poses.desc: Person A stands on the left and person B on the right, facing each other in profile about an arm's length apart. Each raises the right arm high above the head, and their open palms meet overhead at the midpoint between them. Each person's left arm hangs at the side, and both lean slightly forward with the back foot heel lifted.

poses.name: Holding hands running
poses.desc: Person A and person B run side by side toward the camera, person A slightly ahead on the left. Their inside hands are joined and swung forward at waist height. Both are mid-stride with the knees lifted high and the outside arms pumping back. Both torsos lean slightly forward with the chests toward the camera.

poses.name: Warm hug
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other, chests close, seen from the side. Person A's arms wrap around person B's upper back with the hands resting between the shoulder blades, while person B's arms wrap around person A's waist. Each head rests gently against the other's shoulder, and both stand with feet flat and slightly apart.

poses.name: Jumping high ten
poses.desc: Person A and person B face each other in profile, both caught in mid-air with the feet off the ground and the knees bent. Each raises both arms overhead, and all four open palms meet above the midpoint between them in a double high five. Both torsos arch slightly backward with the chests lifted.

poses.name: Leapfrog jump
poses.desc: Person B crouches on the ground in profile with the knees bent, the head tucked down and both hands braced on the knees. Person A is in mid-air directly above, legs spread wide to either side, both hands pressed flat on person B's upper back and the arms straight, vaulting over from behind toward the front.

poses.name: Celebration lift
poses.desc: Person A stands upright facing the camera with the feet planted wide and the knees slightly bent, both arms wrapped around person B's waist and lifting. Person B is raised off the ground directly in front of person A, torso above person A's head, both arms thrown straight up overhead and both legs hanging straight down with the toes pointed.

poses.name: Linked elbows spin
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand side by side facing opposite directions, right elbows hooked together at waist height between them. Each leans slightly outward away from the other, and each raises the free left arm straight up overhead. Both are mid-step with the outside feet lifted, as if spinning around their joined elbows.

poses.name: Mirror palms touching
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in profile, about half an arm's length apart. Both raise the two hands to shoulder height with the elbows bent, and their palms press flat against each other's, person A's right against person B's left and vice versa. Both stand with the feet together and the heads level.

poses.name: Piggyback ride
poses.desc: Person A stands upright facing the camera, carrying person B on the back. Person B's arms wrap loosely around person A's shoulders from behind, hands joined at person A's upper chest. Person B's knees are bent with the legs around person A's sides, and person A's hands hook under person B's knees, elbows pointing backward.

poses.name: Pinky promise
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand facing each other in profile, close together. Each raises the right hand to chest height between them with the little finger extended, and the two little fingers hook together. Each person's left arm hangs at the side. Both heads bow slightly toward the joined hands.

poses.name: Pointing at something together
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand side by side, both turned about forty-five degrees to the right and looking the same way. Person A on the left raises the right arm straight out and points to the upper right with the index finger. Person B's left hand rests on person A's shoulder and person B's right hand shades the eyes, looking along the same line.

poses.name: Selfie together
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand close together facing the camera with the heads tilted toward each other until they nearly touch. Person A on the left extends the left arm straight toward the camera, hand raised as if holding a phone at arm's length. Person B holds up a peace sign beside the cheek with the right hand. Both lean in slightly.

poses.name: Shoulder to shoulder lean
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand side by side facing the camera, shoulders touching, each leaning gently inward so their upper arms press together. Person A on the left rests both hands on the hips, and person B on the right has the arms folded across the chest. Both heads tilt slightly toward each other.

poses.name: Side hug
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand side by side squarely facing the camera, hips touching. Person A on the left wraps the right arm around person B's shoulders with the hand resting on the far shoulder. Person B wraps the left arm around person A's waist. Each person's outer arm hangs relaxed at the side, and both heads lean slightly together.

poses.name: Sitting side by side
poses.desc: Person A and person B sit side by side on an implied ledge facing the camera, lower legs hanging down and swinging slightly apart. Person A on the left leans back on both straight arms with the palms flat behind the hips. Person B leans forward with the elbows on the thighs and the hands clasped between the knees.

poses.name: Tug of war
poses.desc: Person A on the left and person B on the right face each other in profile, each leaning far backward away from the other. Both hold their hands closed at chest height, arms extended toward the middle as if gripping a shared rope. Each has the front knee bent and the back leg straight, heels dug in.

poses.name: Whispering in ear
poses.desc: Person A and person B stand side by side facing the camera. Person A on the left leans toward person B with the right hand cupped beside the mouth, as if whispering, and the head angled toward person B's left ear. Person B tilts the head slightly toward person A and raises the left hand near the chin. Both stand with the feet together.

poses.name: Archery stance empty hands
poses.desc: The figure stands sideways to the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, legs straight, hips square to the side. The left arm extends straight out at shoulder height, hand closed as if gripping a bow. The right arm is pulled back with the elbow high and the hand drawn to the jaw, fingers hooked as if holding a string. The torso is upright. The head looks along the left arm.

poses.name: Cape-like arm spread
poses.desc: The figure stands tall facing the camera with feet planted wider than the shoulders and both legs straight. The chest is lifted and the back slightly arched. Both arms sweep out and down diagonally from the shoulders, elbows straight, palms facing the ground with fingers spread, as if spreading a cape. The head is raised and faces straight forward.

poses.name: Arms crossed wide stance
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet planted wider than the shoulders and both legs straight and locked. The torso is tall and square to the camera. Both arms are crossed firmly over the chest, the right forearm on top, hands tucked under the upper arms. The shoulders are pulled back. The head is level and faces straight ahead.

poses.name: Bracing against wind
poses.desc: The figure leans steeply forward into an invisible headwind, in profile. The right leg is forward with the knee bent and the foot dug in; the left leg is stretched behind, straight, pushing. The torso tilts forward at about forty-five degrees. The right forearm is raised across the face as a shield; the left arm trails behind with the hand open. The head is tucked down behind the forearm.

poses.name: Crouched ready stance
poses.desc: The figure crouches low facing the camera, weight on the balls of both feet, which are set wider than the shoulders. Both knees are bent deeply. The torso leans forward with a flat back. Both arms are bent and held out to the sides at waist height with the hands open and fingers curled, ready to react. The head is lifted and faces straight ahead.

poses.name: Dramatic turn
poses.desc: The figure is caught mid-turn, pivoting on the flat left foot while the right foot lifts onto its toes behind. The hips face away from the camera but the torso twists sharply back so the shoulders face it. The right arm sweeps across the body at chest height with an open hand; the left arm trails behind. The head turns over the right shoulder to face the camera.

poses.name: Fist raised to sky
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart, the right leg straight and the left knee slightly bent. The torso is upright with the chest lifted. The right arm punches straight up overhead with a clenched fist. The left arm is bent with the fist held at the hip. The head tilts back to look up at the raised fist.

poses.name: Fists on hips looking up
poses.desc: The figure stands in a wide, planted stance facing the camera with legs straight and feet turned slightly outward. The torso is upright with the chest pushed forward. Both hands are closed into fists and pressed against the hips with elbows pointing out to the sides. The head tilts up and slightly to the right, as if gazing at the horizon or sky.

poses.name: Flying forward
poses.desc: The figure is airborne and horizontal, flying toward the upper right of the frame, viewed from a low three-quarter angle. The right arm is stretched straight ahead with a clenched fist leading the flight. The left arm is pinned back along the side of the body. Both legs trail behind, straight and together with toes pointed. The torso is long and slightly arched. The head faces forward along the arm.

poses.name: Walking away glance back
poses.desc: The figure walks away from the camera, seen from behind, with the left foot forward and flat and the right heel lifting mid-step. The torso is upright and turned slightly to the right. The right arm swings forward out of sight; the left arm hangs back with the hand open. The head turns over the right shoulder to look back toward the camera.

poses.name: Fist to the ground
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the right knee with the left foot planted flat in front, knee bent, viewed from a low front angle. The torso is folded forward and down. The right fist presses into the ground in front of the right knee, arm straight. The left arm is raised out to the side and back for balance. The head is bowed, facing the planted fist.

poses.name: Hovering in air
poses.desc: The figure floats upright in mid-air, facing the camera, with no contact with the ground. Both legs hang relaxed and slightly bent with the feet dangling and toes pointed down. The torso is upright with a gentle backward lean. Both arms are held out from the sides at hip height with palms facing down, fingers spread, as if steadying a hover. The head faces forward, level.

poses.name: Leap across a gap
poses.desc: The figure is airborne in profile, leaping across an implied gap. The right leg reaches far forward with the knee bent and the foot aimed at a landing point; the left leg bends and trails behind. The torso leans forward. Both arms are swung forward and up at head height with open hands for momentum. The head faces the landing point.

poses.name: Open palm push
poses.desc: The figure lunges forward toward the camera with the right foot in front, knee bent deeply, and the left leg stretched straight behind on its toes. The torso leans forward over the front knee. The right arm thrusts straight forward at chest height with the palm open and facing the camera, fingers spread. The left arm is drawn back with a fist at the hip. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Both hands to the sky
poses.desc: The figure kneels on both knees, facing the camera, with the shins flat on the ground and the hips lifted off the heels. The torso is arched back with the chest open. Both arms are stretched straight up and slightly outward in a wide V with the hands open and fingers spread. The head is thrown back, facing the sky.

poses.name: Rising from a kneel
poses.desc: The figure is halfway up from a kneel, seen from a three-quarter front angle. The left foot is planted flat in front with the knee bent; the right knee is just leaving the ground behind, toes pressed down. The torso leans forward and is rising. The right hand pushes against the right thigh; the left arm hangs forward with the fist loosely closed. The head lifts to face forward.

poses.name: Shielding eyes ahead
poses.desc: The figure stands with the right foot forward on a slight rise, knee bent, and the left leg straight behind, viewed from a three-quarter angle. The torso leans forward. The right hand is raised flat above the brow, palm down, as if shading the eyes to see far ahead. The left arm hangs relaxed at the side with the hand open. The head turns forward and slightly up.

poses.name: Sprinting toward camera
poses.desc: The figure runs directly at the camera, airborne between strides. The right knee drives high toward the lens with the foot flexed; the left leg pushes back and out of view behind the body. The torso leans forward with the shoulders squared to the camera. The left arm pumps forward with a bent elbow and fist; the right arm swings back. The head is lowered slightly, facing the camera.

poses.name: Three-point landing
poses.desc: The figure lands in a low crouch facing the camera. The left foot is planted flat with the knee bent sharply, while the right knee touches the ground beside it. The right hand is planted flat on the ground in front with the arm straight. The left arm is swept back and up behind the body with an open hand. The torso leans forward. The head is lifted, facing forward.

poses.name: Two-handed grip raised
poses.desc: The figure stands in a wide stance facing the camera, the right foot forward and the left foot back, both knees bent. The torso twists slightly to the right. Both hands are stacked together and raised beside the right shoulder with elbows bent, as if holding a long handle angled over the shoulder. The chest is lifted. The head faces forward with the chin level.

poses.name: Adjusting headphones
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on the right leg and the left foot angled outward. Both arms bend upward with the elbows pointing out so each hand cups the side of the head over the ear, as if settling a pair of headphones. The torso is upright and the shoulders slightly raised. The head tilts a touch to the left.

poses.name: Carrying a box
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent to take the load. The torso leans back a few degrees. Both arms bend at the elbows and extend forward at waist height with the palms facing up and the forearms parallel, hands spaced apart as if supporting the bottom of a wide box. The head faces forward above the load.

poses.name: Carrying shopping bags
poses.desc: The figure walks toward the camera with the left foot forward and the torso upright. Both arms hang straight down at the sides, elbows locked, with each hand closed around imagined bag handles at thigh height so the shoulders pull slightly down. The hands are held a few inches away from the legs. The head faces forward, chin level.

poses.name: Carrying a tray
poses.desc: The figure walks toward the camera with the right foot forward and the torso upright and balanced. Both upper arms stay close to the ribs with the elbows bent at right angles, forearms horizontal and the open palms facing up at waist height, spaced apart as if balancing a flat tray. The shoulders are level. The head faces forward, chin level.

poses.name: Checking the time
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on the left leg and the right foot resting a little forward. The left arm bends at the elbow so the forearm is horizontal in front of the stomach, the wrist turned upward. The right hand lightly touches the left wrist. The head bows to look down at the left wrist. The shoulders are relaxed.

poses.name: Drinking from a bottle
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet hip-width apart and weight centered. The right arm lifts with the elbow high so the hand is just in front of the mouth, fingers wrapped around an imagined bottle tilted upward. The left hand rests on the left hip. The head tips back slightly so the chin rises toward the hand.

poses.name: Holding backpack strap
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet staggered, the right foot forward, weight on the back leg. The right arm bends so the right hand grips an imagined strap at the front of the right shoulder, thumb hooked under it. The left arm hangs straight down. The torso is upright. The head faces forward with a slight tilt to the right.

poses.name: Holding a handrail
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet apart and knees slightly bent for balance, as if on a moving train. The right arm reaches straight up above the head with the hand closed around an imagined overhead rail. The left arm hangs at the side with the hand holding an imagined bag strap at the hip. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Holding an umbrella
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet close together and weight centered. The right arm bends at the elbow with the upper arm near the ribs and the forearm angled up and forward, the fist closed around an imagined vertical umbrella handle above the shoulder. The left hand rests in an imagined pocket. The head faces forward, chin slightly tucked.

poses.name: Morning stretch
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet slightly apart and weight on the heels. Both elbows bend and lift so the fists are beside the ears, the upper arms pulled back and the shoulder blades squeezed together. The chest opens and the back arches gently. The head tips back a little with the chin raised, as if mid yawn.

poses.name: Opening a door
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view with the left foot forward and the weight moving onto it. The torso leans slightly forward. The right arm extends forward at waist height with the hand turned sideways, fingers curled as if gripping a door handle and pulling. The left arm hangs back by the hip. The head faces the imagined door.

poses.name: Phone call
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on the right leg and the left foot angled outward. The right arm bends sharply so the right hand is held against the right ear as if holding a phone. The left arm folds across the stomach with the hand supporting the right elbow. The head tilts slightly toward the raised hand.

poses.name: Picking up from floor
poses.desc: The figure bends forward from the hips with both knees bent, feet shoulder-width apart and heels flat. The torso angles down at about sixty degrees. The right arm reaches down toward the ground beside the right foot with the fingers open as if picking something up. The left hand rests on the left knee. The head tilts down toward the floor.

poses.name: Pulling a suitcase
poses.desc: The figure walks forward in three-quarter view with the right foot ahead and weight transferring onto it. The torso is upright. The left arm extends down and behind the body at a diagonal with the hand gripping an imagined telescoping handle at hip height. The right arm swings naturally forward. The head faces the direction of travel.

poses.name: Pushing a cart
poses.desc: The figure walks forward seen in three-quarter view, the left foot ahead and the right heel lifting. The torso leans forward from the hips. Both arms extend forward at waist height with the elbows slightly bent and the hands gripping an imagined horizontal cart handle, knuckles facing up. The head faces forward in the direction of travel.

poses.name: Reaching a high shelf
poses.desc: The figure stands facing slightly left, rising onto the ball of the right foot with the heel lifted while the left foot stays flat. The torso stretches upward. The right arm extends fully overhead with the fingers open as if grasping an item on a high shelf. The left hand rests on an imagined lower shelf at shoulder height. The head tilts up toward the reaching hand.

poses.name: Reading while standing
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet hip-width apart and weight evenly balanced. Both elbows bend close to the ribs so the hands meet in front of the chest at a slight angle, positioned as if holding an open book. The shoulders round slightly forward. The head bows to look down at the space between the hands.

poses.name: Reading on a sofa
poses.desc: The figure sits back on an imagined sofa with the hips deep in the seat and the back reclined. The right leg crosses over the left at the knee, the right foot hanging. Both elbows rest against the ribs with the hands raised in front of the chest, positioned as if holding an open book. The head tilts down toward the hands.

poses.name: Sweeping the floor
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view with feet staggered, the left foot forward and the knees soft. The torso bends slightly forward. Both hands grip an imagined long broom handle at a diagonal: the right hand high near the chest and the left hand lower near the hip, elbows bent. The head angles down toward the floor ahead of the feet.

poses.name: Taking a selfie
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on the left leg and the right hip pushed slightly out. The right arm extends fully up and forward above head height, the hand turned back toward the face as if holding a phone. The left hand rests on the left hip. The head tilts toward the raised arm and faces up at the hand.

poses.name: Texting on a phone
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet hip-width apart and weight slightly on the heels. Both elbows bend so the hands meet in front of the lower chest, thumbs raised above the fingers as if tapping a phone screen held between them. The shoulders round forward slightly. The head bows down to look at the hands.

poses.name: Tying a shoelace
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the right knee with the left foot flat on the ground in front, the left knee bent high. The torso leans forward over the left thigh. Both arms reach down toward the left foot with the elbows bent, fingers positioned as if tying a lace. The head bows to look at the foot, the back rounded.

poses.name: Typing at a laptop
poses.desc: The figure sits on an imagined chair at an imagined desk, hips back and feet flat on the floor beneath the knees. The torso leans slightly forward. Both upper arms hang close to the ribs with the elbows bent at right angles, forearms level, and both hands positioned as if typing on a laptop keyboard with fingers spread. The head tilts down toward the screen area.

poses.name: Waiting with coffee
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on the right leg, the left foot resting slightly ahead. The right elbow bends so the right hand is held at chest height with the fingers curled around an imagined cup. The left arm folds across the stomach, the hand tucked under the right elbow. The head turns to look off to the left.

poses.name: Watering plants
poses.desc: The figure stands in side profile facing right with the right foot a step ahead and weight on it. The torso leans forward slightly. The right arm extends forward and down with the elbow bent, the hand gripping an imagined watering can handle and tilting it. The left hand steadies the imagined spout further forward. The head looks down toward the imagined plant.

poses.name: Adjusting collar
poses.desc: The figure stands at a slight angle to the camera with weight on the right leg and the left foot forward. Both hands rise to the sides of the neck, fingers curled as if straightening a collar, elbows pointing outward and forward. The chest lifts slightly. The head tilts down and to the left as though checking the fit.

poses.name: Adjusting cuff
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet slightly apart and weight on the left leg. The left arm bends in front of the stomach with the forearm horizontal. The right hand reaches across to grip the left wrist, fingers positioned as if fastening a cuff. The shoulders are relaxed and the torso upright. The head bows to look down at the wrists.

poses.name: Arm across waist
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet close together and weight on the right leg, left knee soft. The left arm folds across the front of the waist with the hand gripping the right elbow. The right arm hangs straight down from that elbow. The shoulders are relaxed and slightly asymmetrical. The head turns a few degrees to the right.

poses.name: Coat held open
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and weight centered. Both elbows bend outward and both hands grip at waist height near the hips, pulling outward and slightly back as if holding open the two sides of a long coat. The chest is open and the shoulders back. The head faces forward with the chin raised a little.

poses.name: Fingertips to jaw
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet together, weight evenly spread, legs straight. The right arm lifts with the elbow close to the ribs and the fingertips of the right hand rest lightly along the right side of the jaw, thumb beneath the chin. The left arm hangs straight down. The head tilts a few degrees toward the raised hand.

poses.name: Foot on ledge
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with the right foot flat on the ground and the left foot raised onto an imagined knee-high ledge in front, left knee bent. Weight stays on the back right leg. The left forearm rests across the raised left thigh with the hand hanging. The right hand rests on the right hip. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: Hand at neck looking up
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on the left leg and the right foot resting on its toes slightly behind. The right hand rises to rest on the back of the neck with the elbow pointing up and out. The left arm hangs straight at the side. The chest lifts and the head tips back so the face points up and to the right.

poses.name: Hand in hair
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet staggered, the left foot forward and weight on the back leg. The torso is upright with a gentle sway in the hips. The right arm bends upward so the right hand rests against the side of the head above the ear, elbow pointing out. The left hand rests on the left thigh. The head tilts slightly right.

poses.name: Hand on hip looking away
poses.desc: The figure stands with weight on the straight right leg, the left leg angled out to the side with the knee relaxed. The right hand rests on the right hip, elbow pushed back. The left arm hangs long at the side. The torso faces the camera but the head turns sharply to the left profile, gazing into the distance.

poses.name: Leaning against column
poses.desc: The figure stands with the left shoulder and hip pressed against an imagined tall column at the left. The body faces the camera, weight on the left leg, the right leg straight and angled out with the foot flat. The left arm hangs down along the column. The right hand rests in an imagined pocket.
