The head tilts to rest lightly toward the column.

poses.name: Leaning on railing
poses.desc: The figure stands facing an imagined waist-high railing at the side, body turned in profile to the camera. Both forearms rest flat on the rail with the hands loosely clasped, elbows bent, and the torso leans forward from the hips. The weight rests on the back right leg while the left foot steps forward beneath the rail. The head turns toward the camera.

poses.name: Standing with legs crossed
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with the right leg straight and bearing the weight, the left leg crossing fully in front of it so the left foot rests on its toes beside the outside of the right foot. The hips stay level. Both arms hang long with the hands loosely meeting in front of the thighs. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Looking down at feet
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet staggered, the right foot a step ahead and turned slightly outward, weight on the back leg. Both hands rest in imagined front pockets with the thumbs out. The shoulders drop forward slightly. The head bows down so the face points at the leading foot, the back of the neck exposed.

poses.name: Low crouch
poses.desc: The figure squats low facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart, heels flat on the ground, knees bent fully and spread wide. The torso stays upright between the knees. The right forearm rests across the right knee with the hand hanging loosely, while the left hand touches the ground beside the left foot for balance. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: Over-the-shoulder glance
poses.desc: The figure stands with its back three-quarters to the camera, feet staggered with the right foot forward and weight on the right leg. The torso twists gently to the left. The left hand rises to rest on the left shoulder while the right arm hangs straight. The head turns over the left shoulder so the face angles back toward the camera.

poses.name: Perched on stool
poses.desc: The figure sits on the edge of an imagined tall stool with the hips high. The right foot rests on the ground with the leg straight, and the left foot hooks onto an imagined footrest with the knee bent high. Both hands rest on the left thigh, one on top of the other. The torso is upright and the head turns slightly left.

poses.name: Wide stance pockets
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet planted wider than the shoulders, toes turned out, weight evenly balanced. Both hands sink into imagined front coat pockets so the elbows flare slightly outward. The shoulders sit square and the chest open. The torso is upright. The head faces forward with the chin level, the gaze straight at the camera.

poses.name: Square power stance
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet exactly shoulder-width apart and parallel, weight evenly balanced. The knees are straight and the hips square. The shoulders pull back and down so the chest opens. Both arms hang straight at the sides with the hands open and fingers together, slightly away from the thighs. The head faces forward, chin level.

poses.name: Profile chin up
poses.desc: The figure stands in full side profile facing right, feet together and weight evenly on both soles. The spine is long and the chest lifted. Both arms hang straight at the sides with the fingers extended and relaxed. The chin lifts so the face angles slightly upward, lengthening the neck. The shoulders are drawn back and down.

poses.name: Runway walk
poses.desc: The figure walks straight toward the camera with a long stride, the right foot landing directly in front of the left so the feet trace a single line. The hips swing slightly with each step and the torso stays tall. Both arms hang long and swing in a narrow arc, the left forward and right back. The head faces forward, chin level.

poses.name: Seated on floor
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both knees drawn up and bent, feet flat on the floor slightly apart. The torso leans back a little and both arms stretch behind the body, palms flat on the ground supporting the weight, elbows straight. The shoulders are open. The head faces the camera at a slight upward angle.

poses.name: Sitting on steps
poses.desc: The figure sits on an imagined stair with the hips on a higher step and both feet on a lower one, knees bent and spread slightly apart. The torso leans forward with the forearms resting on the thighs, hands dangling loosely between the knees. The head faces the camera at a slight downward angle.

poses.name: Turning mid-step
poses.desc: The figure is caught mid-turn, pivoting on the ball of the left foot while the right foot swings outward behind it. The hips rotate ahead of the shoulders. Both arms lift away from the body with soft elbows, the hands open at hip height, as if following the momentum. The torso leans slightly back. The head follows the turn, facing to the left.

poses.name: Walking away glance
poses.desc: The figure walks away from the camera, back mostly to the viewer, mid-step with the right foot forward and the left heel lifting. The torso twists slightly to the right. The right arm swings forward and the left hand holds an imagined bag strap at the shoulder. The head turns back over the right shoulder toward the camera.

poses.name: Wall lean foot up
poses.desc: The figure stands with the back and shoulders flat against an imagined wall behind, facing the camera. The left leg is straight with the foot flat, while the right knee bends so the sole of the right foot presses against the wall. Both hands tuck behind the lower back against the wall. The head faces forward, chin level.

poses.name: All fours look back
poses.desc: The figure is on hands and knees in side view, knees hip-width apart and shoulders stacked over the wrists. The spine dips into a deep arch, the chest sinks low and the hips stay high. The feet rest on their tops with toes pointed. The head turns over the near shoulder toward the camera, chin close to the shoulder.

poses.name: Crossed ankles stand
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera with legs crossed at the ankles, front foot planted across the back foot and both knees softly locked together. The hips sway slightly to one side. One arm bends with the hand resting on the waist; the other arm hangs with the hand resting on the outer thigh. The shoulders angle slightly and the head tilts.

poses.name: Armchair leg drape
poses.desc: The figure sits sideways across an implied armchair, the back leaning against one armrest. Both legs stay together, bent at the knees and hooked over the opposite armrest, lower legs dangling with pointed toes. One arm stretches along the armrest behind the head, the other hand rests on the top thigh. The head tips back against the arm.

poses.name: Over the shoulder glance
poses.desc: The figure stands fully with its back to camera, weight on one leg and that hip pushed outward, the other knee bent with only the toes touching the floor. The torso stays upright. One arm hangs at the side, the other hand rests on the front of the waist. The head turns over the shoulder on the hip side to glance back at camera.

poses.name: Lying on back knee raised
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back viewed from the side. The far leg extends straight along the floor, toes pointed. The near knee bends upward, its foot flat on the floor beside the other knee. One arm rests bent above the head on the floor, the other lies across the waist. The head turns to face camera, resting on the floor.

poses.name: Lying stretch arms overhead
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back, viewed from the side. Both arms extend overhead along the floor, wrists loosely crossed. The legs stay together; one knee bends slightly and rolls over the other, toes pointed. The back arches gently off the floor, ribcage lifted as if mid-stretch. The head tilts back and turns toward camera.

poses.name: Back view hip drop
poses.desc: The figure stands with its back to the camera, the weight dropped onto one hip pushed far to the side, the other knee bent inward with the heel raised. The upper body twists slightly toward the camera. One hand rests on the side of the waist, the other arm lifts with the hand on top of the head. The head turns over the shoulder.

poses.name: Back view knees drawn up
poses.desc: The figure sits on an implied bed with its back to the camera, knees drawn up toward the chest and feet flat together. The arms wrap loosely around the shins, hands meeting at the front. The spine stays long and slightly curved, the shoulder blades soft. The head turns in profile over one shoulder, chin dropped toward the collarbone.

poses.name: Backwards chair straddle
poses.desc: The figure sits astride an implied armless chair turned backward, seen in side view, one leg on each side of the seat and the feet flat. The forearms cross over the top of the chair back. The spine arches, hips pushed back on the seat and chest lifted. The head turns over the near shoulder toward the camera, chin resting near the forearm.

poses.name: Beach elbow recline
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back as if on sand, propped up on both elbows behind the shoulders, seen from the side. The far leg extends long with pointed toes and the near knee bends up, foot resting beside the far knee. The chest lifts toward the sky and the shoulders draw back. The head tips back, face turned upward as if into sun.

poses.name: Arched back on bed
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back on an implied bed, seen from the side. The spine arches high so the ribcage lifts off the mattress while the shoulders and hips stay down. The near knee bends upward with the foot flat, the far leg extends long with pointed toes. Both arms bend overhead, hands resting near the crown, and the head tips back with the chin lifted.

poses.name: Bed edge arch
poses.desc: The figure sits on the edge of an implied bed in three-quarter view, knees together and both feet on tiptoe on the floor. The hands plant on the mattress behind the hips, arms straight. The chest lifts and the back arches. The head turns over the near shoulder toward the camera, chin slightly lowered.

poses.name: Catwalk stride
poses.desc: The figure walks toward camera mid-stride, the front foot stepping across the line of the back foot so the hips sway to the side of the back leg. The back heel lifts, toes on the floor. The shoulders stay level and drawn back. Both arms swing lightly at the sides opposite the legs. The head faces straight forward, chin level.

poses.name: Chair back drape
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the seat of an implied chair in side view, facing the chair back. The torso folds forward over the top of the chair back, both arms hanging loosely down the far side. The lower back arches and the hips draw back over the heels. The head lies sideways on the upper arm, turned toward the camera.

poses.name: Crossed knee forward lean
poses.desc: The figure sits on an implied chair in three-quarter view, legs crossed high at the knee with the top foot pointed. The torso leans forward over the knees, both forearms resting stacked on the top knee. The back arches so the chest stays lifted. The head rises and turns toward the camera, chin just above the hands.

poses.name: Side-saddle chair drape
poses.desc: The figure sits sideways on an implied armless chair, knees together and both legs angled to one side, toes pointed. The torso turns toward the implied backrest, the near arm draped over the top of it with the wrist hanging loosely. The other hand rests on the thigh. The back is slightly arched and the head rests near the draped arm, facing camera.

poses.name: Chaise recline
poses.desc: The figure semi-reclines on an implied chaise in side view, the upper back resting against an inclined support at about forty-five degrees. The legs extend along the seat, knees together, the top knee bent slightly over the lower leg with toes pointed. One arm rests along the implied backrest above the head, the other lies on the thigh. The head turns to camera.

poses.name: Chin to shoulder
poses.desc: The figure stands with the body turned in profile, weight on the back leg, front knee softly bent and crossed slightly in front. The torso stays upright with the front shoulder raised a little. Both arms hang relaxed, the front hand resting on the front thigh. The head turns toward camera over the front shoulder, chin lowered to touch the top of it.

poses.name: Hand on collarbone
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view, weight on the back leg and front knee softly bent. The torso is upright with shoulders relaxed and slightly dropped. One hand rises across the body, fingertips resting lightly on the opposite collarbone as if sliding along it, elbow held low. The other arm hangs at the side. The head tilts down toward the raised hand.

poses.name: Glamour curled side lie
poses.desc: The figure lies on its side facing camera with the knees drawn up together toward the waist, lower legs stacked and feet pointed. The lower arm extends along the floor above the head, which rests on it. The top arm bends with the hand resting on the floor in front of the chest. The back curves softly and the head turns slightly toward camera.

poses.name: Deep arch hair lift
poses.desc: The figure stands in profile, feet close together with one knee softly bent forward. The back arches deeply, the chest pushes forward and the hips draw back. Both hands lift to the back of the head with the elbows spread wide and high. The head tips back and slightly toward the camera, lengthening the front of the neck.

poses.name: Doorframe lean
poses.desc: The figure stands sideways leaning one shoulder against an implied doorframe, body angled three-quarter to camera. The near arm rises overhead, forearm resting on the frame above the head. The weight sits on the outer leg, the inner knee bent and crossing in front with toes pointed. The far hand rests on the hip. The head leans against the raised arm.

poses.name: Perched with crossed legs
poses.desc: The figure perches on the very front edge of an implied seat in three-quarter view, back straight and slightly arched. The legs cross at the knee, top leg draped over the lower one, both shins angled together diagonally with toes pointed. Both hands rest stacked on the top knee. The shoulders turn slightly toward camera and the head tilts.

poses.name: Elbow recline crossed legs
poses.desc: The figure reclines on the floor in side view, propped on both forearms behind the torso. The legs extend long together, crossed at the ankles with the toes pointed. The near knee softens slightly. The chest lifts and the shoulders draw back. The head tips back and turns slightly toward the camera.

poses.name: Side sit leaning back
poses.desc: The figure sits on the floor in three-quarter view with both legs folded to one side, knees together and stacked, feet tucked near the hip. The torso leans back and away from the legs, supported by the straight arm planted behind, palm flat on the floor. The other hand rests on the top knee. The shoulders drop and the head tilts toward camera.

poses.name: Floor twist knees dropped
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back on an implied bed or floor, chest facing up while the hips roll to one side. Both knees bend together and drop toward the floor on that side. The arms extend loosely overhead with soft elbows, wrists crossing. The waist twists in a long curve and the head turns away from the knees.

poses.name: Forearms resting on head
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view, weight on the back leg with the hip pushed out and the front knee bent across. Both arms rise so the forearms cross and rest on top of the head, elbows pointing outward to the sides. The torso lengthens with a gentle side curve away from the hip. The head tilts toward the raised hip side.

poses.name: Forward lean hands on thighs
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera, feet together and knees softly bent and pressed together. The hips push slightly back while the torso bends forward about thirty degrees from the hips, back gently arched. Both hands rest on the front of the thighs just above the knees, elbows bent and angled out. The shoulders lift slightly forward and the head raises to face camera.

poses.name: Hair flip
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera with feet apart and weight shifting onto one leg, the other knee bent. The torso arches back as the head swings upward and to one side, chin lifted. One hand sweeps up past the temple to the back of the head as if flipping the hair, elbow high. The other arm swings out from the side for balance.

poses.name: Hand on hip pose
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera in contrapposto, weight on one leg with that hip pushed out, the other leg extended slightly forward and to the side with the knee relaxed and toes pointed. One hand rests on the raised hip, elbow pointing outward. The other arm hangs loosely, fingers relaxed. The shoulders tilt opposite the hips and the head tilts slightly.

poses.name: Glamour face frame
poses.desc: The figure is shown from the chest up facing camera, shoulders level and slightly drawn back. Both arms bend upward with elbows close together in front of the body. The palms open at the sides of the jaw, fingertips extending along the cheeks to frame the head without pressing. The head tilts slightly to one side, chin lowered.

poses.name: Hands in hair stand
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera with weight on one leg and the other knee bent inward, hip shifted to the weight side. Both arms rise with elbows pointing up and outward, hands raised to the back of the head as if running through the hair. The ribcage lifts and the back arches slightly. The head tilts back and to one side.

poses.name: Head over bed edge
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back across an implied bed in side view, the head and shoulders hanging back over the edge so the neck extends downward. Both arms trail overhead toward the floor, fingers loose. The knees bend together with the feet flat on the mattress. The chest lifts in a gentle arch.

poses.name: Hip shift thigh slide
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view with the weight sunk onto the back leg and that hip pushed far out. The front knee bends inward across the standing leg, heel lifted. One hand slides down the outer front thigh with fingertips trailing, the other arm bends up with the hand at the back of the neck. The head tilts down toward the raised elbow.

poses.name: Sitting hugging knees
poses.desc: The figure sits on the floor in side view, knees drawn up together toward the chest, feet flat and close to the hips with toes pointed. Both arms wrap around the shins, hands clasped over the front of the ankles. The back curves gently. The cheek rests on the tops of the knees with the head turned toward camera.

poses.name: Knee pop stand
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera with weight fully on one straight leg. The other knee bends and turns inward across the standing knee, heel lifted with only the toes touching the floor. The hips tilt toward the standing leg. One hand rests on the outer thigh of the bent leg, the other on the waist. The head tilts toward the lifted heel.

poses.name: Kneeling arch hands in hair
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright in three-quarter view, knees together and hip-width from the feet, thighs vertical, tops of the feet flat behind. The back arches, chest lifted and hips pressed slightly forward. Both arms are raised, elbows out, hands at the back of the head as if running through the hair. The head tilts back and turns toward camera.

poses.name: Upright kneel hands on thighs
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright facing camera, knees together on the floor, thighs vertical and lower legs extending back with toes pointed. The hips press slightly forward and the lower back arches, chest lifted. Both hands rest flat on the fronts of the thighs, arms straight. The shoulders draw back and down and the head tilts slightly to one side.

poses.name: Kneeling lean back
poses.desc: The figure kneels and sits back on its heels in three-quarter view, knees together. Both hands reach behind and plant on the floor beyond the feet, fingers pointing away, arms straight. The torso leans back from the knees, the chest lifts and the spine arches in a long curve. The head drops gently back, the throat lengthened, turned slightly toward the camera.

poses.name: Sitting on heels arched
poses.desc: The figure kneels and sits back on its heels in three-quarter view, knees together and tops of the feet flat on the floor. The torso stays upright with a pronounced arch in the lower back, chest lifted. Both hands rest lightly on the tops of the thighs, fingers pointing toward the knees. The shoulders relax back and the head turns toward camera.

poses.name: Kneeling overhead stretch
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright in three-quarter view, knees together and hips pushed out to one side. Both arms stretch straight overhead with the wrists crossed. The torso lengthens and curves away from the pushed-out hip, ribcage lifted. The head turns toward one side beneath the raised arms, chin slightly lifted.

poses.name: Kneeling back view twist
poses.desc: The figure kneels and sits on its heels with its back to the camera, knees together. The torso twists toward one side, the near hand planted on the floor beside the hip. The other hand rests at the nape of the neck with the elbow lifted. The spine curves through the twist and the head turns back over the shoulder.

poses.name: Lying legs raised crossed
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back in side view, head and shoulders slightly raised on both elbows behind. Both legs rise together toward the ceiling at an angle, crossed at the ankles, knees slightly bent and toes pointed. The hips rest on the floor. The forearms lie flat on the floor supporting the upper body. The head tilts back and turns toward camera.

poses.name: Lingerie lunge
poses.desc: The figure stands in a shallow lunge in three-quarter view, the front knee bent and the back leg straight with the heel lifted. Both hands rest stacked on the front thigh just above the knee. The torso leans forward with the back arched and the chest lifted. The head rises toward the camera, chin slightly down.

poses.name: Long leg reach sit
poses.desc: The figure sits sideways on an implied bed in side view, one knee drawn up toward the chest and the other leg extended long with pointed toes. One hand props behind the hip. The other hand glides along the extended shin toward the ankle. The torso leans toward the reaching hand and the head tilts toward the raised knee.

poses.name: Long leg side lie
poses.desc: The figure lies on its side facing the camera, propped on the lower forearm with the elbow under the shoulder. The bottom leg bends back at the knee while the top leg extends long and straight in line with the torso, toes pointed. The waist dips into a curve. The top hand rests on the outer top thigh and the head tilts toward the raised shoulder.

poses.name: Mermaid sit
poses.desc: The figure sits on one hip on the floor in side view, both legs bent and swept back together behind it, knees stacked and feet trailing with toes pointed. The torso rises upright, supported by the near arm planted straight beside the hip. The far hand rests on the near knee. The waist curves toward the supporting arm and the head turns to camera.

poses.name: Off-the-shoulder slip
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view, weight on the back leg, front knee bent and turned in. The near shoulder rolls forward and drops. The far hand crosses the chest and rests on the near upper arm as if easing an implied loose fabric down off the shoulder. The other arm hangs relaxed. The head tilts down toward the bared shoulder.

poses.name: One knee kneel twist
poses.desc: The figure kneels on one knee in three-quarter view, the other foot planted flat in front with the knee raised. The torso stays upright and twists toward the raised knee, with the back slightly arched. The far forearm rests across the raised knee, wrist relaxed. The near hand rests on the floor-side thigh. The head turns over the shoulder toward camera.

poses.name: Arched back look back
poses.desc: The figure stands with its back to the camera, feet hip-width apart and weight on one leg, the other knee softly bent. The lower back arches noticeably, chest lifted away from camera. The torso twists so the near shoulder drops toward camera. Both hands rest lightly at the waist. The head turns over the near shoulder, chin close to it, looking back at camera.

poses.name: Pin-up bend and kick
poses.desc: The figure bends forward at the hips in three-quarter view, the standing leg straight. Both hands rest just above the knee of the standing leg. The other leg kicks up behind with the knee bent and the foot pointed toward the ceiling. The back stays flat with a slight arch and the head lifts toward the camera.

poses.name: Pin-up crouch
poses.desc: The figure crouches low on the balls of both feet in three-quarter view, knees pressed together and angled toward one side. One forearm rests across the tops of the knees. The other hand rests lightly at the jaw. The back stays straight with a slight arch and the head tilts toward the raised hand.

poses.name: Pin-up high kick
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view on one straight leg. The other leg kicks forward and up to hip height, knee straight and toes pointed. The torso leans back to balance. One arm reaches up and out with the palm open, the other hand rests on the hip of the standing leg. The head tilts back and toward the camera.

poses.name: Pin-up leg kick
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view on one straight leg, the other leg kicked back with the knee bent so the lower leg rises behind, toes pointed. The torso leans slightly forward from the hips. Both hands clasp lightly at the chest with elbows tucked in. The shoulders lift slightly and the head tilts toward camera.

poses.name: Classic pin-up sit
poses.desc: The figure sits upright on an implied seat in three-quarter view, knees pressed together and both legs angled diagonally to one side, feet together with toes pointed and heels lifted. The back is straight with a slight arch, chest lifted. One hand rests on the top knee, the other on the seat behind the hip. The head tilts and faces camera.

poses.name: Prone arch ankles crossed
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach on an implied bed facing the camera, the chest lifted high on nearly straight arms with the palms flat under the shoulders. The lower back arches deeply and the hips stay pressed down. Both lower legs rise behind and cross at the ankles with pointed toes. The head tilts to one side, chin slightly lowered.

poses.name: Prone on forearms
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach in three-quarter view, upper body raised on both forearms placed forward, elbows under the shoulders and hands loosely together. The legs extend straight back together, toes pointed. The lower back arches, lifting the chest. The shoulders draw slightly forward and the head tilts toward one shoulder, turned toward camera.

poses.name: Prone twist look up
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach on an implied bed with the shoulders twisted toward the camera, propped on the near elbow. The far hand rests flat on the mattress in front of the chest. The back arches through the twist. The legs extend behind, one knee bent so the lower leg lifts with the foot pointed. The head lifts toward the camera.

poses.name: Raised knee lean
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view with one foot raised onto an implied low ledge, the knee bent high. The near forearm rests across the raised knee and the torso leans forward over it with the back arched. The other hand rests on the hip of the standing leg. The head turns toward the camera.

poses.name: S-curve stand
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view with weight on the back leg, hip pushed out toward the side. The front knee bends and crosses slightly in front, toes pointed. The torso leans gently away from the hip, forming an S-curve. One hand rests on the pushed-out hip, the other arm hangs loosely. The head tilts toward the raised shoulder, facing camera.

poses.name: Seated back to camera
poses.desc: The figure sits on the floor with its back to camera, legs folded to one side with knees together. The spine stays tall with a slight arch, shoulders relaxed. The near arm plants on the floor beside the hip for support; the far hand rests on the knees. The torso twists slightly and the head turns over the near shoulder to look back at camera.

poses.name: Seated lean back on hands
poses.desc: The figure sits on the floor facing three-quarter to camera, legs extended forward together and crossed at the ankles, toes pointed. The torso leans back at about forty-five degrees, supported by both straight arms planted behind the hips, fingers pointing backward. The chest lifts and the shoulders drop. The head tilts back slightly and turns toward camera.

poses.name: Seated leg raise
poses.desc: The figure sits on the floor in side view, leaning back on one straight arm with the hand planted behind the hip. The near leg rises straight toward the ceiling on a diagonal, toes pointed, while the far knee bends with the foot flat. The free hand reaches up along the raised shin toward the ankle. The head tilts back.

poses.name: Shallow water side lounge
poses.desc: The figure lies on its side as if in shallow water, propped on the straight lower arm with the hand planted. The legs stack and extend long, the top knee slightly bent forward. The top hand sweeps back over the crown of the head, elbow lifted. The waist curves and the head tilts back toward the sky.

poses.name: Shoreline kneel arch
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright as if at the water's edge, knees together and hips lifted off the heels, seen in three-quarter view. The torso arches back and twists toward the camera. One hand sweeps back over the top of the head, the other rests on the top of the near thigh. The head tilts back and to the side.

poses.name: Standing side bend
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera with feet together and weight shifted onto one leg, the hip pushed out on that side. The arm on the opposite side reaches up and over the head, bending the torso into a long side curve away from the hip. The other hand rests on the pushed-out hip. The head tilts with the curve, chin slightly lifted.

poses.name: Side lie arm overhead
poses.desc: The figure lies on its side facing the camera on an implied bed, the head resting on the lower arm stretched along the mattress. The top arm arches over the head, hand dangling near the far side. The top knee bends forward and rests on the bed in front of the straight bottom leg. The waist dips into a curve.

poses.name: Side lie back view
poses.desc: The figure lies on its side with its back to camera, propped on the lower elbow. The legs extend long and stacked, the top knee bent slightly forward and resting on the floor. The waist dips and the hip rises, forming a curve. The top arm rests along the side with the hand on the hip. The head turns over the top shoulder to look back.

poses.name: Side lie head on hand
poses.desc: The figure lies on its side facing camera, the lower elbow on the floor and the head resting on that hand. The legs extend long, stacked together, with the top knee bent slightly forward over the lower knee and toes pointed. The waist dips and the hip rises. The top arm drapes along the side, hand resting on the thigh.

poses.name: Side recline on elbow
poses.desc: The figure lies on its side facing camera, propped up on the lower forearm with the elbow under the shoulder. The lower leg extends straight, toes pointed. The top leg bends, its knee resting forward on the floor in front of the lower leg. The waist dips toward the floor, hip raised. The top hand rests on the top hip. The head tilts toward the supporting shoulder.

poses.name: Side sit shoulder hold
poses.desc: The figure sits on one hip on an implied bed in three-quarter view, both legs folded together behind to the far side. The far hand plants on the mattress beside the hip, arm straight. The near hand crosses the chest to rest on the far shoulder. The back arches with the chest lifted, and the head tucks the chin down toward the near shoulder.

poses.name: Spiral reach
poses.desc: The figure stands in profile with feet close and weight on the back leg, hips drawn back. The upper body spirals toward the camera. One arm stretches straight overhead with the hand reaching high, the other hand trails down the outer thigh. The waist lengthens on the reaching side and the head tilts back under the raised arm.

poses.name: Lying on stomach feet up
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach facing camera, propped on both forearms with elbows on the floor beneath the shoulders. The hands are stacked under the chin, supporting it. The knees bend so the lower legs rise behind, feet crossed at the ankles with toes pointed upward. The back arches gently. The head tilts slightly to one side, facing camera.

poses.name: Stool arch lean back
poses.desc: The figure sits on the front edge of an implied tall stool in profile. One foot rests on an implied rung with the knee bent high, the other leg extends down to the floor with pointed toes. Both hands grip the seat behind the hips, arms straight. The torso leans back with an arched spine and the head drops back.

poses.name: Tall stool perch
poses.desc: The figure sits on the front edge of an implied tall stool in three-quarter view. One foot rests on an implied rung with the knee raised; the other leg extends down to the floor, toes pointed, knees angled together. The back is straight and lightly arched. One hand rests on the raised knee, the other grips the seat beside the hip. The head faces camera.

poses.name: Shoulder strap adjust
poses.desc: The figure stands in three-quarter view, weight on the back leg with the front knee bent inward. The near shoulder drops slightly forward. The far hand crosses the body to the near shoulder, fingers pinched at the top of the shoulder as if adjusting a shoulder strap. The other arm hangs relaxed. The head tilts down toward the near shoulder, gaze lowered.

poses.name: Leaning on elbows
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera and bends forward at the hips, resting both forearms on an implied waist-high surface in front, elbows planted and hands loosely clasped. The legs stay straight with one foot crossed behind the other at the ankle. The back stays long with a slight arch. The shoulders lift a little and the head rises to face camera.

poses.name: Fingertips at temple
poses.desc: The figure is shown from the waist up in three-quarter view, shoulders relaxed and slightly turned away from camera. One arm bends up with the elbow lowered in front of the chest and the fingertips resting lightly at the temple, wrist soft. The other arm hangs relaxed. The head tilts gently into the fingertips, chin lowered, turned toward camera.

poses.name: Tiptoe arms overhead
poses.desc: The figure stands facing camera on the balls of both feet, heels raised, legs straight and together. The body elongates upward with a slight arch in the lower back. Both arms reach straight overhead, hands loosely clasped at the wrists above the head. The ribcage lifts. The head tilts slightly back with the chin raised toward one side.

poses.name: Upright kneel hip drop
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright on an implied bed in three-quarter view, knees together, hips dropped and pushed to one side. One hand rests at the back of the neck with the elbow raised high. The other hand slides down the side of the torso toward the hip. The waist curves and the head tilts toward the raised elbow.

poses.name: Wading stride
poses.desc: The figure walks toward the camera as if through shallow water, one knee lifting high mid-step and the foot pointed. The hips swing toward the standing leg and the shoulders draw back. Both arms trail out to the sides at hip height, palms down and fingertips skimming as if over the surface. The head turns slightly to one side.

poses.name: Waist slide arch
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with the weight on one leg and the other knee bent inward. Both hands slide up the sides of the waist with the elbows pointing out. The back arches, the chest lifts and the shoulders draw back. The hip shifts toward the standing leg and the head tips back with the chin lifted.

poses.name: Wall arch back view
poses.desc: The figure stands facing an implied wall with its back to the camera, forearms resting on the wall above the head. The weight shifts onto one hip, the other knee bending inward with the heel raised. The lower back arches gently. The head turns in profile over one shoulder toward the camera.

poses.name: Glamour wall lean
poses.desc: The figure leans its back and shoulders against an implied wall, body angled three-quarter to camera. Weight rests on the straight standing leg. The other knee bends forward and up, sole of that foot pressed flat against the wall behind. Both hands rest against the wall at hip level. The chin lowers slightly and the head turns toward camera.

poses.name: Wet look hair sweep
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera as if knee-deep in shallow water, one knee bent forward and the hip shifted to the side. Both hands sweep from the forehead back over the crown, elbows pointing forward and up. The chest lifts and the back arches. The head tips back with the chin raised, as if rising out of the water.

poses.name: Kneeling arms raised
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright on both knees facing the camera, thighs vertical and hips lifted off the heels, shins flat on the floor. Both arms reach straight up overhead in a wide V with the palms open and facing forward, fingers spread. The chest is lifted and the back is slightly arched. The head tilts back to look upward.

poses.name: Folded forward on knees
poses.desc: The figure kneels with the hips resting on the heels, knees slightly apart, and folds the torso forward until the chest rests on the thighs and the forehead nearly touches the floor. Both arms stretch straight forward along the ground with the palms flat and fingers spread. The figure is in profile, facing the left of the frame.

poses.name: Crouch hands on knees
poses.desc: The figure crouches facing the camera on the balls of both feet, heels lifted, feet slightly apart with the left knee dropped lower and close to the floor and the right knee higher. The torso is upright. Each hand grips the matching knee with the arms straight and elbows locked. The head is level and faces the camera.

poses.name: Crouch one hand down
poses.desc: The figure crouches on the balls of both feet, angled to the right of the camera, heels lifted and knees bent deeply. The torso leans forward. The left hand is planted flat on the floor in front, arm straight, taking some weight. The right forearm rests across the right thigh with the hand hanging over the knee. The head is turned toward the camera.

poses.name: Deep squat arms on knees
poses.desc: The figure squats low facing the camera with both feet flat on the floor slightly wider than the hips, toes turned out, and the hips dropped close to the heels. The torso leans slightly forward and the back is rounded gently. Each forearm rests on top of the matching knee with the hands hanging loosely between the knees. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Half kneel hands on hips
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the right knee, angled slightly to the right of the camera, with the right shin flat on the floor and the left foot planted forward with the knee at a right angle. The torso is upright and the chest is open. Both hands are placed on the hips with the elbows pointing outward. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: Half kneel looking up
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the left knee with the left shin flat on the floor and the right foot planted forward, right knee bent at a right angle. The torso is upright and turned slightly left. The right hand rests on the right thigh; the left arm hangs by the side. The head tilts back to look straight upward above the camera.

poses.name: Kneel hands on thighs
poses.desc: The figure kneels facing the camera with the hips resting on the heels, shins flat on the floor and knees slightly apart. The torso is upright, shoulders rounded gently forward. Both hands rest palms down on the tops of the thighs, fingers pointing toward the knees. The head is bowed, with the face angled toward the floor in front.

poses.name: Kneeling hands pressed together
poses.desc: The figure kneels facing the camera with the hips resting on the heels and the shins flat, knees together. The torso is upright and still. Both hands are pressed together palm to palm in front of the chest, fingers pointing upward, elbows held out to the sides at a gentle angle. The head bows slightly forward, face angled down.

poses.name: Kneeling leaning back
poses.desc: The figure kneels facing the camera with the hips resting on the heels and the shins flat on the floor, knees slightly apart. The torso leans backward, supported by both arms straight behind the body with the palms flat on the floor behind the feet, fingers pointing back. The chest is open and the head tilts slightly upward.

poses.name: Kneeling on all fours
poses.desc: The figure kneels on both knees in profile, facing the left of the frame, and leans forward so both hands are planted flat on the floor directly below the shoulders, arms straight. The thighs are vertical and the shins are flat on the ground, forming a tabletop with the back flat and horizontal. The head faces down toward the floor.

poses.name: One knee leaning on knee
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the left knee in profile facing the right of the frame, left shin flat on the floor, right foot planted forward with the right knee bent past a right angle. The torso leans forward over the front leg. Both forearms rest stacked on top of the right thigh near the knee. The head turns to face the camera.

poses.name: One knee chin on fist
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the left knee facing the camera, with the left shin flat on the floor and the right foot planted ahead, right knee bent. The torso leans forward. The right elbow rests on the right knee with the fist propping the chin. The left hand rests on the left thigh. The head tilts slightly to the right, facing the camera.

poses.name: One knee down
poses.desc: The figure kneels on the right knee facing the camera, the right shin flat on the floor and the left foot planted ahead with the left knee bent at a right angle. The torso is upright with the weight centered. Both hands rest stacked on top of the left knee, elbows relaxed. The head faces forward, level with the camera.

poses.name: Kneeling reaching to side
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright on both knees facing the camera, hips lifted off the heels and shins flat. The torso bends to the right and slightly forward. The right arm reaches down toward the floor to the right of the knee, fingers spread as if picking something up. The left arm extends out to the left side for balance. The head looks down at the right hand.

poses.name: Kneeling shading eyes
poses.desc: The figure kneels upright on both knees, angled to the left of the camera, hips lifted off the heels and shins flat on the floor. The torso is tall and leans slightly forward. The right hand is raised flat above the brow with the palm down, as if shading the eyes to look into the distance. The left hand rests on the left thigh. The head faces left.

poses.name: Kneeling arms crossed
poses.desc: The figure kneels on both knees in profile facing the right of the frame, hips lifted off the heels so the thighs are vertical and the shins lie flat on the floor. The torso is upright. Both arms are folded across the chest with each hand tucked under the opposite elbow. The head turns toward the camera over the left shoulder.

poses.name: Sitting on heels
poses.desc: The figure kneels with the back to the camera, both shins flat on the floor and the hips lowered to rest on the heels. Knees are together and point away from the camera. The spine is upright. Each hand rests palm down on the matching thigh near the knee, elbows slightly bent. The head faces away, level and still.

poses.name: Sprinter start crouch
poses.desc: The figure crouches in profile facing the left of the frame. The left foot is planted forward with the knee bent sharply; the right knee rests on the floor behind with the right toes tucked under. Both hands are placed on the ground just ahead of the front foot, shoulder-width apart, arms straight. The back is flat and the head looks forward along the ground.

poses.name: Squat hands clasped
poses.desc: The figure squats facing the camera with both feet flat on the floor at hip width and the hips lowered near the heels, knees pointing forward. The torso is upright. Both elbows rest on the inside of the knees, and the hands are pressed together in front of the chest with fingers pointing up. The head faces forward with the chin level.

poses.name: Squat heels up
poses.desc: The figure squats facing the camera on the balls of both feet with the heels raised high off the floor, knees bent deeply and pointing forward, feet close together. The torso is upright with the weight balanced over the toes. Both arms extend straight forward at shoulder height, palms down, for balance. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Squat hugging shins
poses.desc: The figure squats facing the camera with both feet flat on the floor and together, hips dropped all the way down to the heels, knees pressed close to the chest. Both arms wrap around the front of the shins with the hands clasped near the ankles. The back is rounded and the chin rests on top of the knees, face toward the camera.

poses.name: Squat reaching forward
poses.desc: The figure squats low on the balls of both feet, angled to the left of the camera, with the heels raised and knees bent fully. The torso leans forward over the knees. The right arm extends forward and downward with the fingers nearly touching the ground, as if examining something. The left hand rests on the left knee. The head looks down at the right hand.

poses.name: Kneeling twist back
poses.desc: The figure kneels with the back to the camera, hips resting on the heels and shins flat on the floor. The torso twists to the left, and the head turns to look back over the left shoulder toward the camera. The left hand rests flat on the floor beside the left hip for support; the right hand rests on the right knee.

poses.name: Upright kneel
poses.desc: The figure kneels on both knees facing the camera with the shins flat on the floor and the thighs vertical, so the hips are lifted off the heels. Knees are hip-width apart and the tops of the feet rest on the ground. The torso is straight and tall. Both arms hang relaxed at the sides with palms facing the thighs. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Lying, ankle on knee
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back facing upward with the head resting on the ground. The left knee is bent with the foot flat on the ground, and the right ankle rests across the left thigh just above the knee, the right knee pointing out to the side. Both hands rest behind the head with the elbows wide.

poses.name: Flat and still
poses.desc: The figure lies completely flat on its back facing upward with the head centered and resting on the ground. Both arms lie straight along the sides of the body, slightly away from the hips, palms turned up. Both legs extend straight and parallel, feet about hip width apart and falling naturally outward.

poses.name: Arms behind head
poses.desc: The figure lies flat on its back on the ground, facing straight up. Both elbows are bent out to the sides and both hands are stacked behind the back of the head, cradling it. The legs are extended straight and relaxed, slightly apart, with the toes pointing loosely upward and outward.

poses.name: Arms wide ankles crossed
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back facing upward with the head centered on the ground. Both arms extend straight out to the sides at shoulder height, forming a T shape, with the palms facing up. The legs extend straight along the ground with the ankles crossed, the left foot resting over the right.

poses.name: Hands on stomach
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back facing upward with the head resting on the ground. Both elbows are bent and the two hands are folded together over the stomach, fingers loosely interlaced. The legs extend straight along the ground with the ankles crossed, right over left, and the feet relaxed.

poses.name: Both knees bent
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back facing upward with the head on the ground. Both knees are bent and point toward the ceiling, with both feet planted flat on the ground about hip width apart. The arms rest straight along the sides of the body with the palms pressed flat to the ground.

poses.name: Knees dropped to side
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back with the shoulders flat on the ground and both arms stretched out to the sides at shoulder height, palms down. Both knees are bent together and dropped over to the left so they rest on the ground, feet stacked, creating a gentle twist through the waist. The head is turned to the right.

poses.name: Hugging knees
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back with the head and upper back on the ground. Both knees are drawn tightly up toward the chest, feet off the ground and ankles relaxed. Both arms wrap around the shins just below the knees, hands clasped together, holding the legs in a compact bundle against the torso.

poses.name: One arm overhead stretch
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back facing upward, body long and stretched. The right arm extends straight overhead along the ground past the head, palm up, while the left arm rests along the side. Both legs extend straight with the toes pointed, the whole body elongated in a single line as if stretching after waking.

poses.name: One knee bent
poses.desc: The figure lies flat on its back facing upward, head resting on the ground. The right knee is bent upward so the right foot is planted flat on the ground, while the left leg is extended straight. The right arm rests along the side with the palm down, and the left hand rests on the stomach.

poses.name: Propped on both elbows
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back with the upper body raised at an angle, supported on both elbows planted behind the torso, forearms flat on the ground pointing forward and hands open. The head is lifted and looks forward toward the feet. Both legs extend straight ahead along the ground with the feet slightly apart.

poses.name: Reaching up to sky
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back facing upward with the head on the ground. The right arm is raised straight up toward the ceiling, fingers spread as if reaching for something overhead. The left arm rests along the side. The left knee is bent with the foot flat, and the right leg lies straight.

poses.name: Arms and legs raised
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back with the head and shoulders flat on the ground. Both arms are raised straight up toward the ceiling, fingertips pointing upward. Both hips and knees are bent at right angles so the thighs point straight up and the lower legs are parallel to the ground, feet relaxed.

poses.name: Curled on side
poses.desc: The figure lies on its right side, body curled into a compact shape and seen in profile. Both knees are drawn up toward the chest, hips bent deeply, feet tucked near the seat. Both arms are folded in front of the chest with the hands gathered together near the chin, and the head is tucked slightly forward.

poses.name: Legs up the wall
poses.desc: The figure lies on its back with the seat close to an implied wall, seen from the side. Both legs extend straight up vertically, resting against the implied vertical surface, feet relaxed and ankles together. The torso lies flat along the ground and both arms rest out to the sides at shoulder height, palms up.

poses.name: Head on outstretched arm
poses.desc: The figure lies on its left side in profile, with the left arm extended straight along the ground above the head and the head resting on the upper arm. The right arm lies along the right side of the body with the hand on the thigh. Both legs are extended and stacked, with the knees very slightly bent.

poses.name: Side leg lift
poses.desc: The figure lies on its left side in profile, propped on the left forearm with the elbow under the shoulder. The left leg extends straight along the ground. The right leg is raised straight up and out to about forty-five degrees from the ground, toes pointed. The right hand rests on the ground in front of the hips for balance.

poses.name: Propped on one elbow
poses.desc: The figure lies on its left side in profile to the camera, upper body raised and supported on the left forearm, left elbow planted on the ground directly under the shoulder. The right hand rests on the right hip. Both legs are extended along the ground, the right leg stacked on top of the left with knees slightly bent.

poses.name: Side with top knee forward
poses.desc: The figure lies on its right side, seen in profile. The lower right leg is extended straight along the ground while the upper left knee is bent and brought forward to rest on the ground in front of the body. The right arm extends forward along the ground and the left hand rests flat on the ground in front of the chest.

poses.name: Starfish spread
poses.desc: The figure lies flat on its back facing upward with the limbs spread as wide as possible. Both arms extend straight out and upward at about forty-five degrees above the shoulders, palms up. Both legs extend straight and spread wide apart, forming a large X shape with the whole body pressed to the ground.

poses.name: Arms stretched forward
poses.desc: The figure lies face down on its stomach, seen from the side, with the chest slightly lifted. Both arms extend straight forward along the ground beyond the head, palms down and shoulder width apart. Both legs extend straight behind, feet slightly lifted off the ground, forming a long line from fingertips to toes.

poses.name: Cheek on forearm
poses.desc: The figure lies face down on its stomach with the head turned to the left, the left cheek resting on the left forearm, which is folded flat on the ground beneath the head. The right arm lies straight along the right side of the body, palm up. Both legs extend straight behind with the feet relaxed outward.

poses.name: Chin on hands
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach facing the camera, upper chest lifted off the ground. Both elbows are planted shoulder width apart, forearms angled inward, and the chin rests on the backs of the two stacked hands. The legs are extended straight behind, flat on the ground, ankles relaxed and feet together.

poses.name: Reading on stomach
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach facing the camera, propped up on both forearms with the elbows under the shoulders and the hands flat on the ground as if holding a book open. Both knees are bent so the lower legs rise straight up behind, the two feet crossed at the ankles in the air.

poses.name: Propped on forearms
poses.desc: The figure lies on its stomach at a three-quarter angle to the camera, upper body lifted and resting on both forearms, which lie flat and parallel on the ground with the elbows under the shoulders. The head is held level, looking forward. The legs extend straight behind, flat on the ground, with the feet relaxed and slightly apart.
