poses.name: Ankle on knee
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height facing the camera, leaning back slightly. The right ankle rests on the left knee so the right shin lies horizontal, left foot flat on the floor. The right hand holds the right ankle; the left forearm rests along the left thigh. Shoulders are open and relaxed, head facing forward.

poses.name: Arm over backrest
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, body turned about forty-five degrees to the right. The right arm is draped backward over the top of the backrest, the forearm hanging down behind it. The left hand rests on the left thigh. Both feet are flat on the floor, knees apart at hip width. The head turns over the right shoulder toward the camera.

poses.name: Seated with arms crossed
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, torso upright and turned slightly to the left, back touching the backrest. Both arms are folded across the chest, each hand tucked under the opposite upper arm. Knees are apart at hip width, feet flat on the floor. The head turns toward the camera with the chin slightly raised.

poses.name: Back turned looking over
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height with the back to the camera, both feet flat on the floor and knees apart at hip width. The torso twists to the right and the head turns to look back over the right shoulder toward the camera. The right hand rests on the backrest top; the left hand rests on the left thigh.

poses.name: Chin on hand
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height facing the camera, leaning slightly forward and to the right. The right elbow is planted on the right knee with the fist propping the chin, head tilted a little to the right. The left forearm lies across the left thigh. Both feet are flat on the floor with knees bent at right angles.

poses.name: Sitting on desk edge
poses.desc: The figure sits on a high edge at desk height, hips at the very rim. The left foot reaches the floor with the leg nearly straight; the right leg dangles freely with the foot off the ground. Both hands rest on the edge just outside the hips, arms straight and shoulders slightly shrugged. The torso faces the camera, head level.

poses.name: Perched on edge
poses.desc: The figure perches on the front edge at chair height with only the back of the thighs touching the seat. The torso is upright and leaning slightly forward. Feet are flat, pulled slightly back under the knees as if ready to stand. Both hands grip the front edge of the seat beside the thighs, arms straight. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Elbows on knees
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, leaning forward from the hips so the torso angles about forty-five degrees. Feet are flat and slightly wider than the hips, knees bent. Both elbows rest on the thighs just above the knees, forearms angled inward with the hands loosely clasped between the knees. The head is lifted, looking forward at the camera.

poses.name: Feet hooked back
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height facing the camera with the torso upright. Both feet are pulled back under the seat, heels raised and toes on the floor, shins angled backward. Both hands rest on top of the thighs near the knees, arms straight and elbows locked. The shoulders are slightly raised. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Seated, hands behind head
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, leaning back so the torso reclines against the backrest. Both hands are interlaced behind the back of the head with elbows pointing out to the sides. The right ankle rests on the left knee; the left foot is flat on the floor. The head faces the camera, tilted slightly upward.

poses.name: Hands clasped in lap
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height facing the camera with a straight back, knees together and feet flat on the floor, ankles side by side. Both hands are folded together in the lap, fingers interlaced, elbows resting lightly against the sides of the body. Shoulders are relaxed and even. The head is level and faces straight ahead.

poses.name: Seated, hands on knees
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height facing the camera, torso upright and leaning very slightly forward. Knees are apart a little wider than the hips, feet flat on the floor pointing forward. Each hand grips the matching knee with fingers wrapped around the kneecap, arms straight and elbows locked. The head is level, looking straight ahead.

poses.name: Hands under thighs
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height facing the camera, shoulders rounded slightly forward. Both hands are tucked palms-down under the thighs, arms straight and elbows locked, as if keeping them warm. The ankles are crossed left over right beneath the seat, toes touching the floor. The head is tilted slightly to the right, looking at the camera.

poses.name: Head tilted back
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, torso reclined against the backrest. The head is tipped fully back so the chin points upward, as if resting the neck on the top of the backrest. Both arms hang relaxed along the sides with hands resting on the seat. Legs extend forward with knees slightly bent, feet flat, toes out.

poses.name: Holding a cup
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height in profile, facing the left of the frame. The back is upright and the knees are together, feet flat on the floor. Both hands are raised to chest height just in front of the body, cupped together as if holding a warm cup. Elbows are bent and tucked near the ribs. The head tilts slightly down.

poses.name: Knee hugged on seat
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, turned slightly to the left. The right foot is placed up on the seat so the right knee rises toward the chest; both arms wrap around the right shin, hands clasped near the ankle. The left foot stays flat on the floor. The chin rests on top of the right knee, face toward the camera.

poses.name: Leaning on armrest
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, torso leaning to the left with the left forearm resting at armrest height beside the body and the left hand supporting the side of the head at the temple. The right hand lies in the lap. The left knee is crossed over the right, right foot flat. The head tilts toward the left hand.

poses.name: Legs crossed
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, angled slightly to the left of the camera. The right thigh is crossed over the left, right foot hanging loosely beside the left shin, left foot flat on the floor. The torso is upright and relaxed. Both hands rest stacked on the top knee. The head turns toward the camera.

poses.name: Legs stretched out
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, leaning back against the backrest with the torso slightly reclined. Both legs extend straight forward along the floor, ankles crossed right over left, heels resting on the ground with toes pointing up. Both arms are folded across the chest. The head faces the camera with the chin level.

poses.name: One arm raised
poses.desc: The figure sits upright at chair height facing the camera with feet flat on the floor and knees at hip width. The right arm is raised straight overhead with the palm open facing forward, as if asking a question. The left hand rests on the left thigh. The torso is straight, head level and looking forward.

poses.name: One foot tucked under
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height facing the camera. The left leg is folded with the left foot tucked beneath the right thigh, the left knee pointing outward. The right foot rests flat on the floor. The torso is upright and relaxed. The right hand rests on the right knee; the left hand rests on the left ankle. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Reading on chair
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, angled to the right of the camera, with the right leg crossed over the left at the knee. Both hands are raised in front of the chest at shoulder width, palms facing inward, as if holding an open book. Elbows rest against the sides. The head tilts downward toward the hands.

poses.name: Sitting sideways
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height with the hips turned ninety degrees so both legs point to the left of the frame, knees together and feet flat on the floor. The torso twists back toward the camera. The right hand rests on the right thigh; the left hand rests on the seat beside the hip for support. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: Slouched back
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height with the hips slid forward and the upper back pressed into the backrest, spine rounded in a slouch. Legs extend forward with knees slightly bent and feet flat, toes pointing outward. Both arms hang limp over the sides of the seat with hands dangling. The chin drops slightly toward the chest.

poses.name: Lounging on sofa
poses.desc: The figure sits deep in a low seat at sofa height, torso reclined and sunk back, angled to the right of the camera. Both legs stretch forward and the right ankle crosses over the left on the floor. The right arm extends sideways along the cushion top; the left hand rests on the stomach. The head rests back, facing the camera.

poses.name: Straddling backwards
poses.desc: The figure sits backward at chair height, straddling the seat so the backrest is in front of the chest. Knees are bent and set apart around the seat, feet flat on the floor. Both forearms are crossed and rest on top of the backrest, with the chin resting on the stacked forearms. The head faces directly toward the camera.

poses.name: Stretching overhead
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height facing the camera, lower back arched slightly away from the backrest. Both arms reach straight up over the head with the fingers of both hands interlaced and palms turned toward the ceiling in a stretch. Legs extend forward with heels on the floor and toes up. The head tilts back, looking upward.

poses.name: Tying a shoe
poses.desc: The figure sits at chair height, bent forward deeply from the hips with the chest near the thighs. The right foot is flat on the floor; the left foot is drawn in with the heel lifted. Both hands reach down to the left foot, fingers near the laces as if tying a shoe. The head is lowered, looking at the foot.

poses.name: Typing at desk
poses.desc: The figure sits upright at chair height facing the camera, as if at a desk. Both forearms extend forward at waist height, parallel to the floor, elbows bent at right angles close to the body, hands hovering with fingers curled as if resting on a keyboard. Feet are flat on the floor, knees bent. The head tilts slightly downward as if looking at a screen.

poses.name: Upright neutral
poses.desc: The figure sits upright at chair height, facing the camera squarely, with weight evenly on both hips. Both feet rest flat on the floor hip-width apart, knees bent at right angles. The back is straight, shoulders level and relaxed. Both forearms rest on the thighs with palms down, fingers loose. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Arms draped over knees
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both knees bent and raised, feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. The torso leans back slightly. Both arms drape loosely over the tops of the knees with the forearms hanging down in front of the shins, wrists relaxed. The head is level, looking at the camera.

poses.name: Butterfly stretch
poses.desc: The figure sits upright on the ground facing the camera with the soles of both feet pressed together in front of the body, knees bent outward and dropping toward the floor. Both hands hold the feet, fingers wrapped around the toes, elbows resting lightly on the inner thighs. The back is straight. The head faces forward with the chin level.

poses.name: Chin on one knee
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground, turned about forty-five degrees to the left. The left knee is drawn up to the chest with the left foot flat on the floor, while the right leg lies bent on the ground with the foot tucked near the left ankle. Both arms hug the left shin. The chin rests on the left knee, head turned toward the camera.

poses.name: Cross-legged basic
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with the legs crossed at the shins, each foot tucked beneath the opposite knee, knees spread wide and low. The torso is upright with the weight centered on the sit bones. Both hands rest palms down on the knees, elbows slightly bent. The head faces forward at a level angle.

poses.name: Cross-legged arms overhead
poses.desc: The figure sits cross-legged on the ground facing the camera, feet tucked beneath the opposite knees, back straight. Both arms reach straight up over the head, palms pressed together above the crown with the elbows nearly straight. Shoulders are pulled down away from the ears. The head faces forward with the chin slightly lifted.

poses.name: Cross-legged back turned
poses.desc: The figure sits cross-legged on the ground with the back to the camera, the feet tucked beneath the opposite knees and the knees spread wide. The spine is straight and the shoulders are square. Both arms are relaxed with the hands resting flat on the floor just outside the knees, elbows slightly bent. The head faces away from the camera.

poses.name: Cross-legged holding something
poses.desc: The figure sits cross-legged on the ground facing the camera, back upright, feet tucked beneath the opposite knees. Both hands are raised to the middle of the chest and cupped together, palms up, as if holding a small bowl. Elbows are bent and held close to the ribs. The head tilts downward slightly toward the hands.

poses.name: Cross-legged leaning forward
poses.desc: The figure sits cross-legged on the ground, angled slightly to the right of the camera, feet tucked under the opposite knees. The torso leans forward from the hips at about thirty degrees. Both elbows rest on the knees with the forearms angled inward and the hands loosely hanging between the knees. The head is up, looking at the camera.

poses.name: One leg tucked under
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground angled to the left of the camera. The right leg is folded beneath the body with the weight resting on the right shin and heel; the left leg extends straight forward along the floor with the toes up. The torso is upright. Both hands rest on the left thigh, one over the other. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: Hands on shins
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both legs extended straight forward and together, feet flexed with toes up. The torso leans slightly forward from the hips. Both arms reach down along the legs, each hand resting on the matching shin halfway between knee and ankle. The head is lowered a little, looking toward the feet.

poses.name: Head down on arms
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both knees bent and raised, feet flat and together. Both forearms are crossed and stacked on top of the knees. The torso curls forward, and the forehead rests on the crossed forearms so the face points down toward the floor. The back is rounded and the shoulders are relaxed.

poses.name: Holding ankles
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both knees bent and spread apart, feet flat on the floor wider than the hips. The torso leans slightly forward. Each arm reaches down inside the matching knee, with each hand gripping the matching ankle. The elbows are bent and pointing outward. The head is level, facing the camera.

poses.name: Kneel sit
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both legs folded beneath the body, shins flat on the floor and the weight resting on the heels. Knees are together and point forward. The back is straight and tall. Both hands are placed one over the other in the lap, fingers relaxed. The head faces forward and is level.

poses.name: Knees hugged to chest
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both knees drawn up tightly to the chest, feet flat and together on the floor. Both arms wrap around the shins, hands clasped together at the front of the ankles. The back is rounded, and the chin rests on top of the knees. The head looks straight at the camera.

poses.name: Knees to side looking up
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both knees bent and dropped together to the left, feet resting on the floor to the left of the hips. The torso leans back, supported by both arms straight behind the body with palms flat on the floor. The chin is lifted and the head tilts back to look upward.

poses.name: Leaning back on hands
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both legs extended forward, knees slightly bent and ankles crossed. The torso leans back at about thirty degrees, supported by both arms straight behind the body with palms flat on the floor and fingers pointing backward. Shoulders are relaxed. The head faces forward, chin slightly lifted.

poses.name: Leaning on hand
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground with the legs loosely crossed at the ankles in front, knees relaxed outward. The torso leans to the left onto a straight left arm with the palm flat on the floor. The right hand is raised in front of the face at eye level, fingers curled as if holding a small device. The head tilts down toward the hand.

poses.name: Legs out on one elbow
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground turned to the right side of the frame. Both legs extend to the right along the floor, the top leg slightly bent over the lower one. The torso leans left onto the left elbow, which rests on the floor with the forearm flat. The right hand rests on the right hip. The head turns toward the camera.

poses.name: Legs in a V
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with both legs extended straight and spread into a moderate V shape, toes pointing upward. The torso is upright and the back is straight. Both arms extend forward between the legs with the palms flat on the floor in front, elbows slightly bent. The head faces forward with the chin level.

poses.name: Meditation palms up
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground cross-legged facing the camera, each foot resting on top of the opposite thigh, knees pressing down toward the floor. The spine is tall and the shoulders are back. Both hands rest on the knees with palms facing upward, thumb and index finger lightly touching. The head is level and faces straight ahead.

poses.name: One arm hugging knees
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground angled to the right of the camera with both knees bent and raised, feet flat on the floor together. The right arm wraps around the front of both shins, hand resting on the left knee. The left arm is straight and planted behind the hip with the palm on the floor. The head turns toward the camera.

poses.name: One knee up
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground angled to the left of the camera. The right knee is bent and raised with the right foot flat on the floor; the left leg lies flat, bent inward with the foot near the right ankle. The right forearm rests across the top of the right knee, hand hanging. The left palm is on the floor behind the hip. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: One leg extended
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera. The left leg extends straight forward with the toes pointing up; the right leg is bent with the right foot flat on the floor and the knee raised. The right hand rests on top of the right knee. The left arm is straight with the palm on the floor beside the left hip. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Reaching for toes
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground in profile facing the left of the frame, both legs extended straight and together along the floor with toes pointing up. The torso folds forward over the legs, back rounded. Both arms stretch forward along the shins with the hands reaching toward the feet, fingertips near the toes. The head hangs down toward the knees.

poses.name: Reclining on both elbows
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera, leaning far back so the torso is supported by both elbows planted on the floor behind the body, forearms flat and hands pointing backward. Both legs extend forward and are slightly apart, knees a little bent, heels on the floor. The head is upright, looking toward the feet and the camera.

poses.name: Seated twist
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with the left leg extended straight forward and the right knee bent, right foot planted on the floor outside the left knee. The torso twists to the right. The left elbow presses against the outside of the right knee, and the right hand rests flat on the floor behind the hips. The head turns right.

poses.name: Side sit
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground with both legs folded to the right side, knees bent and stacked, feet trailing behind to the right. Weight rests on the left hip. The left arm is straight with the palm on the floor beside the hip for support; the right hand rests on the right thigh. The torso faces the camera, head turned slightly left.

poses.name: Side sit back turned
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground with the back to the camera, both legs folded to the left side so the feet trail toward the left of the frame. Weight rests on the right hip, with the right hand flat on the floor beside it and the arm straight. The left hand rests on the left knee. The head turns to look back over the right shoulder.

poses.name: Side sit reaching out
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground with both legs folded to the right, knees bent and stacked, weight on the left hip. The left hand is flat on the floor beside the hip, arm straight. The right arm extends forward and slightly upward at shoulder height, fingers open as if reaching for something. The head follows the reaching hand.

poses.name: Side stretch over leg
poses.desc: The figure sits on the ground facing the camera with the right leg extended straight out to the right side, toes up, and the left leg folded in with the foot against the inner right thigh. The torso bends sideways to the right over the extended leg. The right hand holds the right shin; the left arm arcs overhead toward the right foot. The head looks up under the arm.

poses.name: Arms crossed
poses.desc: The figure stands squarely facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, weight balanced on both feet. The legs are straight and the hips level. Both arms fold across the chest at mid-torso height: the right forearm lies on top, the right hand tucked under the left upper arm, the left hand gripping the right upper arm. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Arms outstretched wide
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera, feet wider than the hips, weight evenly spread, knees straight. The torso is upright and the chest open. Both arms extend straight out to the sides at shoulder height forming a T shape, palms facing forward and fingers spread. The head faces forward, chin level, with the neck long and relaxed.

poses.name: Arms raised in V
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and knees straight, weight evenly centered. The chest lifts and the back arches slightly. Both arms extend straight up and outward above the head to form a wide V shape, palms open and facing forward, fingers spread. The head tilts back a little, looking upward past the hands.

poses.name: Back to camera
poses.desc: The figure stands with its back fully to the camera, feet hip-width apart and weight evenly balanced. The legs are straight and the hips and shoulders square away from the viewer. Both arms hang relaxed at the sides with the backs of the hands visible. The head faces directly away so only the back of the head and neck are seen.

poses.name: Both hands in pockets
poses.desc: The figure stands with feet slightly wider than the hips, weight sinking evenly into both heels. The knees are soft, not locked. The shoulders roll gently forward and down, and both elbows bend back so each hand slides into an imagined front pocket at hip level. The torso leans back a few degrees. The head faces forward, chin slightly lowered.

poses.name: Classic contrapposto
poses.desc: The figure stands with weight shifted onto the straight right leg while the left knee bends slightly and the left foot rests lightly a half step forward. The hips tilt so the right hip rises, and the shoulders tilt the opposite way to balance. Both arms hang loosely at the sides. The head turns slightly toward the left shoulder.

poses.name: Ankles crossed
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with the right leg straight and bearing the weight while the left leg crosses in front of it, the left foot resting on its outer edge beside the right foot. The hips stay level. Both hands tuck into imagined back pockets so the elbows point backward. The head faces forward, tilted slightly left.

poses.name: Elbow propped on wall
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on the straight right leg, the left foot angled out. The torso leans slightly to the right. The right arm lifts to shoulder height and bends so the right forearm rests against an imagined wall at the right, the hand hanging loosely. The left hand tucks into an imagined pocket. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: Wide power stance
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet planted well wider than the shoulders, toes angled slightly outward, weight evenly sunk into both legs. The knees are straight. The torso is upright and the chest lifted. Both arms hang straight down at the sides, hands open and a few inches away from the thighs. The head faces forward, chin level.

poses.name: Fists at sides
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart, weight sunk evenly into both legs and knees straight. The chest lifts and the shoulders pull down and back. Both arms hang straight down with the hands closed into firm fists beside the thighs, elbows slightly flexed. The head faces forward, chin level and neck straight.

poses.name: Hand in pocket
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight mostly on the left leg, the right foot angled outward a few inches to the side. The torso is upright and relaxed. The right arm hangs with the hand tucked into an imagined front trouser pocket, thumb resting outside. The left arm hangs straight at the side. The head faces forward, tilted slightly right.

poses.name: Hand on chin
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with weight on the right leg and the left foot slightly forward. The torso is upright. The left arm folds across the stomach so the left hand supports the right elbow. The right forearm rises vertically and the right hand rests under the chin with the index finger along the jaw. The head tilts slightly to the right.

poses.name: Shielding eyes
poses.desc: The figure stands facing slightly left of the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and weight on the forward left foot. The torso leans a little forward. The right arm bends so the flat right hand rests horizontally above the brow like a visor, palm down. The left hand rests on the left hip. The head turns to gaze into the distance to the left.

poses.name: Hands behind back
poses.desc: The figure stands tall facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart and weight evenly on both heels. The chest is open and the shoulders pulled back. Both arms go behind the body where the left hand grips the right wrist at the small of the back. The elbows point slightly outward. The head faces forward with the chin raised a touch.

poses.name: Hands behind head
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet hip-width apart and weight evenly balanced. The legs are straight. Both elbows point outward at shoulder height as both hands go behind the head, fingers interlaced at the back of the skull. The chest opens and the upper back arches slightly. The head faces forward with the chin level.

poses.name: Hands clasped in front
poses.desc: The figure stands upright facing the camera, feet close together with weight evenly spread. The legs are straight and the hips level. Both arms hang down and the hands meet in front of the lower stomach, fingers interlaced and thumbs resting on top. The shoulders are relaxed and slightly rounded. The head faces forward with the chin level.

poses.name: Hands on hips
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and weight centered. Both knees are straight. The torso is upright with shoulders pulled slightly back. Both elbows bend outward so each hand rests on the top of its own hip, fingers pointing forward and thumbs behind. The head faces forward with the chin raised a touch.

poses.name: Bent over, hands on knees
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart, both knees bent, weight forward over the toes. The torso hinges forward from the hips to about forty-five degrees, back flat. Both arms are straight with each hand pressed onto its own kneecap, elbows locked. The head lifts to face the camera from under the shoulder line.

poses.name: Palms pressed together
poses.desc: The figure stands upright facing the camera, feet together with weight evenly distributed, legs straight. The elbows bend and point slightly out so both palms press flat together in front of the chest, fingertips pointing upward just below the chin. The shoulders are relaxed and the chest open. The head bows forward slightly toward the hands.

poses.name: Leaning on wall
poses.desc: The figure stands with the right shoulder and upper back pressed against an imagined wall to the right, body turned three-quarters toward the camera. The right foot is flat, the left foot crosses in front of it at the ankle resting on its toes. Both arms fold loosely across the stomach. The head turns toward the camera, tilted slightly.

poses.name: Looking down
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet close together and weight slightly forward over the toes. The legs are straight. The shoulders round forward gently and both arms hang in front of the thighs with the hands loosely overlapping. The head bows forward so the face points down at the ground just in front of the feet.

poses.name: Looking back over shoulder
poses.desc: The figure stands with its back almost fully to the camera, feet hip-width apart and weight on the left leg. The hips face away but the torso twists to the right so the right shoulder drops back. The right arm hangs straight down and the left hand rests on the left hip. The head turns over the right shoulder toward the camera.

poses.name: Looking up
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera, feet hip-width apart with weight evenly on both legs. The torso is upright and the chest lifts slightly. Both arms hang loosely at the sides with the fingers relaxed. The neck extends and the head tips back so the face points upward toward the sky, the chin raised high above the shoulders.

poses.name: Mid-stride profile
poses.desc: The figure is seen in full side profile walking from right to left. The leading left leg is extended forward with the heel just touching the ground, the trailing right leg straight behind with the toes pushing off. The torso is upright. The right arm swings forward with a soft elbow, the left arm swings back. The head faces the direction of travel.

poses.name: Neutral stance
poses.desc: The figure stands upright facing the camera with feet hip-width apart and weight evenly distributed on both soles. Both legs are straight without locking the knees. The hips and torso are square to the viewer, shoulders level and relaxed. Both arms hang naturally at the sides with fingers loosely curled. The head faces directly forward, chin level.

poses.name: On tiptoes
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera balanced on the balls of both feet with the heels lifted high, feet close together. The legs are straight and the whole body stretches upward. The torso is tall and the arms rise slightly out to the sides at hip height for balance, palms facing down. The head faces forward with the chin lifted.

poses.name: One hand on hip
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and weight shifted onto the right leg, the left knee soft. The right hand rests on the right hip with the elbow bent outward, while the left arm hangs straight down with relaxed fingers. The shoulders stay level and the torso upright. The head faces forward with the chin level.

poses.name: One hand raised high
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet together and weight evenly centered, legs straight. The torso is upright and the shoulders level. The right arm reaches fully straight up above the head with the palm open and facing forward, as if asking a question. The left arm hangs down at the side. The head faces forward, chin slightly lifted.

poses.name: Overhead stretch
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera, feet together and weight evenly on both soles. The legs are straight and the torso elongates upward. Both arms reach straight up above the head, fingers interlaced and palms turned toward the sky, elbows locked. The ribcage lifts and the shoulders rise near the ears. The head tilts back slightly to look upward.

poses.name: Palms open forward
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet hip-width apart, weight evenly balanced and knees straight. Both elbows bend close to the ribs so the forearms angle forward and slightly outward, hands open at chest height with both palms facing the camera and fingers spread. The shoulders are relaxed. The head faces forward, chin level.

poses.name: Pointing forward
poses.desc: The figure stands with the left foot a half step ahead and weight leaning forward onto it, the right leg straight behind. The torso tilts forward slightly. The right arm extends fully toward the camera at shoulder height with the index finger pointed and the other fingers curled. The left arm hangs down behind the hip. The head faces the camera directly.

poses.name: Pointing to the side
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, weight centered. The torso stays square to the viewer. The left arm extends straight out to the left at shoulder height, index finger pointing away from the body. The right arm hangs relaxed at the side. The head turns to the left, following the direction of the pointing finger.

poses.name: Full profile stance
poses.desc: The figure stands in exact side profile facing left, feet together with weight evenly on both soles. The legs are straight and the spine tall. Both arms hang straight down along the sides so the near arm hides most of the far arm. The shoulders are relaxed and the chest neutral. The head faces left in profile, chin level with the floor.

poses.name: Shrugging shoulders
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera with feet shoulder-width apart and weight centered. Both shoulders lift high toward the ears. Both elbows bend and tuck near the ribs so the forearms angle outward, hands open at waist height with palms turned up toward the ceiling. The head tilts to one side. The knees are straight and the hips level.

poses.name: Side stretch
poses.desc: The figure stands with feet wider than the hips, weight evenly on both feet, legs straight. The right arm reaches straight overhead and arcs to the left so the torso bends sideways at the waist, creating a long curve down the right side. The left hand rests on the left thigh. The head stays in line with the spine, facing the camera.

poses.name: Three-quarter turn
poses.desc: The figure stands turned about forty-five degrees to the right of the camera, feet staggered with the left foot forward and weight on the back right leg. The hips and shoulders follow the same angle. The left arm hangs relaxed in front, the right arm hangs behind the hip. The head turns back toward the camera so the face is seen three-quarters.

poses.name: Thumbs up
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera, feet hip-width apart, weight evenly balanced and knees straight. The torso is upright. The right arm bends at the elbow so the forearm angles forward and up, the right fist closed with the thumb pointing to the sky at chest height. The left arm hangs relaxed at the side. The head faces forward.

poses.name: Walking toward camera
poses.desc: The figure walks directly toward the camera. The right foot lands heel first in front with the knee slightly bent and the weight shifting onto it, while the left leg trails behind with the heel lifting off the ground. The torso is upright and leans faintly forward. The left arm swings forward and the right arm swings back. The head faces straight ahead.

poses.name: Waving hello
poses.desc: The figure stands facing the camera, feet hip-width apart, weight evenly balanced on both legs. The torso is upright and the shoulders relaxed. The right arm rises with the elbow bent at a right angle, forearm vertical, open palm facing the camera at head height. The left arm hangs at the side. The head faces forward, tilted slightly toward the raised hand.

poses.name: Weight on one leg
poses.desc: The figure stands with all weight on the straight left leg. The right knee bends and the right foot lifts so only its toes touch the ground a few inches to the side. The left hip juts outward and the shoulders tilt gently the other way. The right hand rests on the right hip, the left arm hangs straight. The head faces the camera.

poses.name: Adjusting glasses
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the body angled slightly to the right. The right hand is raised to the face with the index finger and thumb pinched together at the bridge of the nose, as if pushing glasses up. The left arm is folded across the body at waist height.

poses.name: Arms folded
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera squarely with the shoulders pulled back and the chest open. Both arms are folded across the chest, the right forearm on top of the left, each hand tucked against the opposite upper arm. The head is held level and looks straight ahead.

poses.name: Arms raised cheering
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the chest open. Both arms are thrown straight up overhead in a wide V shape, the hands open with the fingers spread and the palms facing forward. The head is tilted slightly back as if cheering toward the sky.

poses.name: Arms wide welcome
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the chest open and the head held high. Both arms are spread wide out to the sides at slightly below shoulder height, the elbows softly bent and the palms open and turned toward the camera in a welcoming gesture.

poses.name: Chin on crossed arms
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure leans forward toward the camera with both forearms resting flat on an implied surface at chest height, crossed one over the other. The chin rests on the top forearm, so the head is low and level with the shoulders, which are raised slightly. The back is rounded gently forward.

poses.name: Clapping hands
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the chest lifted. Both elbows are bent and held in front of the body at chest height, and the two open hands meet palm to palm in mid-clap, the fingers of the right hand angled across those of the left. The shoulders are slightly raised with energy.

poses.name: Finger heart
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the head tilted slightly to the left. The right hand is raised in front of the chest at shoulder height with the thumb and index finger crossed at their tips to form a small heart shape, the other fingers curled. The left arm hangs relaxed at the side.

poses.name: Thinking finger on temple
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure is turned about thirty degrees to the right with the head turned slightly back toward the camera. The right elbow is bent and the extended index finger touches the right temple, the remaining fingers folded. The left arm is folded across the stomach, the left hand tucked under the right elbow.

poses.name: Finger pointing up
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the body angled slightly to the left. The right arm is bent with the elbow near the ribs and the hand raised beside the head, index finger pointing straight up as if making a point or having an idea. The left arm rests across the waist.

poses.name: Flexing biceps
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the shoulders square. Both arms are raised out to the sides and bent sharply at the elbows so the fists point upward beside the head, upper arms level with the shoulders, in a double bicep flex. The head is held straight and level.

poses.name: Hand on chin, half body
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the shoulders square. The right elbow rests on an implied surface at waist height, forearm vertical, and the right hand is loosely closed with the thumb and knuckles tucked under the chin, supporting the head. The head tilts slightly to the right. The left arm rests across the waist.

poses.name: Hand on heart
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the shoulders relaxed. The right hand is placed flat against the left side of the chest over the heart, fingers together and elbow pointing down. The left arm hangs straight at the side. The head is bowed very slightly forward in a sincere gesture.

poses.name: Hand over mouth
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the head tilted slightly down and to the left. The right hand covers the mouth with the fingers together and the palm toward the face, elbow pointing down, as if stifling a laugh. The left arm is wrapped across the stomach, the hand holding the right elbow.

poses.name: Raising a hand
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the body angled slightly to the right. The right arm is raised straight up above the head with the palm open and facing forward, fingers together, as if asking a question in a classroom. The left hand rests on an implied surface at waist height.

poses.name: Hands behind head, half body
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera and leans back slightly as if against a chair. Both elbows are bent wide out to the sides and both hands are clasped behind the back of the head, fingers interlaced. The chest is open and the head rests back into the hands.

poses.name: Hands clasped under chin
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the head tilted slightly to the right. Both elbows are bent and held close to the chest, and the two hands are clasped together with the fingers interlaced, resting just under the chin. The shoulders are lifted slightly toward the ears.

poses.name: Hands framing face
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera directly. Both elbows are bent and lifted to shoulder height, and both hands are held open on either side of the face with the palms facing inward and the fingers pointing up, as if forming a frame around the head without touching it.

poses.name: Hands on cheeks
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera directly with the shoulders slightly raised. Both elbows are bent and lifted, and both palms press flat against the cheeks on either side of the face, fingers pointing upward past the ears, as if reacting in surprise. The head is pulled slightly back.

poses.name: Hands on hips, half body
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the shoulders square and the chest lifted. Both hands are placed on the hips with the fingers forward and the thumbs behind, both elbows pointing straight out to the sides to form a wide shape. The head is held high and level.

poses.name: Heart arms overhead
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera directly. Both arms are raised above the head with the elbows bent outward, and the two hands meet above the top of the head with the fingertips touching, so the arms outline a large heart shape around the head. The shoulders are relaxed down.

poses.name: Holding cup both hands
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the shoulders relaxed and slightly rounded forward. Both elbows are bent and held close to the body, and both hands are cupped together in front of the upper chest, just below the chin, as if wrapping around a warm cup. The head tilts slightly down toward the hands.

poses.name: Looking over shoulder
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure stands with its back turned to the camera, the torso twisted so the head and right shoulder turn back to look toward the viewer. The right hand rests on the right shoulder from the front, and the left arm hangs straight along the left side. The head is turned over the right shoulder.

poses.name: OK sign
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the shoulders square. The right hand is raised to shoulder height with the thumb and index finger touching to form a circle and the other three fingers extended upward, palm facing the camera. The left arm hangs relaxed at the side with the hand open.

poses.name: Palms together
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the back straight. Both palms are pressed flat together in front of the center of the chest with the fingers pointing straight up and the elbows pointing out to the sides. The head is bowed slightly forward in a respectful greeting.

poses.name: Peace sign
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the body angled slightly to the left. The right hand is raised beside the right cheek with the index and middle fingers extended in a V shape and the other fingers folded, palm facing the camera. The left arm hangs relaxed at the side.

poses.name: Phone to ear
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure is turned about thirty degrees to the right. The right hand is raised to the right ear with the fingers curled as if holding a phone, elbow pointing down and slightly out. The left arm is folded across the stomach with the hand tucked under the right elbow. The head tilts a little toward the raised hand.

poses.name: Pointing at camera, half body
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera squarely. The right arm is extended straight toward the camera at shoulder height with the index finger pointing directly at the viewer and the other fingers folded. The left hand rests on the left hip with the elbow out to the side.

poses.name: Profile hand on neck
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure stands in full profile facing left. The left hand is raised to rest on the back of the neck with the elbow pointing up and back, the upper arm angled behind the head. The right arm hangs straight at the near side of the body. The head is tilted slightly downward.

poses.name: Standing salute
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the back straight and the shoulders pulled back. The right hand is raised in a crisp salute, the fingers together and straight with the fingertips touching the right side of the forehead, elbow angled out to the side. The left arm is held straight down at the side.

poses.name: Shh finger to lips
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the head tilted slightly forward. The right hand is raised to the mouth with the index finger held vertically across the lips and the other fingers folded, in a hushing gesture. The left arm hangs loosely at the side with the hand relaxed.

poses.name: Shielding eyes, half body
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the body angled slightly to the right and the head turned to look into the distance to the left. The right hand is raised flat above the eyes, palm down, like a visor, elbow pointing out. The left hand rests on the left hip.

poses.name: Shrug palms up
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with both shoulders raised high toward the ears. Both elbows are bent and held at waist height out to the sides, with the forearms angled outward and both palms turned up and open. The head tilts to one side in a questioning gesture.

poses.name: Thumbs up, half body
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the shoulders square. The right arm is bent at the elbow and held in front of the chest with the fist closed and the thumb pointing straight up toward the camera. The left arm hangs relaxed at the side with the hand slightly open.

poses.name: Tucking hair behind ear
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure is turned about forty-five degrees to the left with the head turned back toward the camera. The right hand is raised to the side of the head with the fingers curled lightly near the right ear, as if tucking hair behind it. The left arm hangs relaxed at the side, the shoulders soft.

poses.name: Waving hello, half body
poses.desc: Framed from the waist up, the figure faces the camera with the body angled slightly to the left. The right arm is raised with the elbow bent at about ninety degrees and the hand held up beside the head, palm open and facing the camera, fingers together in a wave. The left arm hangs naturally at the side.
